单段内容使用 Collapsible；不得用隐藏内容暗示已经阅读或完成。
keepMounted 保留真实表单字段，应用决定是否禁用隐藏字段。

props.name: hiddenUntilFound
props.description: 收起的内容用 hidden="until-found" 留在文档里：浏览器的页内查找（Ctrl/Cmd+F）命中其中的文字，或地址栏片段指向其中的元素时，自动展开该项。Chrome 102+、Firefox 148+ 支持，Safari 不支持；不支持的浏览器上与默认相同（命中不到，需手动展开）。开启后 keepMounted 无效（必须保留挂载）。收起内容的高度过渡与 opacity 过渡由 motion.css 照常处理，命中时由原语直接展开、不播放过渡。
props.descriptionEn: Closed content stays in the document as hidden="until-found": the browser's find-in-page (Ctrl/Cmd+F) matching text inside it, or a URL fragment pointing at an element inside it, opens the item automatically. Supported in Chrome 102+ and Firefox 148+, not Safari; where unsupported it behaves as the default (no match, open manually). keepMounted is ignored while it is on, since the panel must stay mounted. motion.css handles the opacity transition as usual; a find match opens the item immediately without the transition.

components.name: alert
components.title: 就地说明 Alert
components.description: 静态就地说明，按实际需要显式宣告。

props.name: tone
props.description: 已声明事实的类别。色相之外还有形状不同的默认图标，与只给读屏的类别前缀（「警告：」等，随语言）；neutral 无类别，两者都没有。去掉图标不去掉前缀。
props.descriptionEn: The declared kind of fact. Besides hue there is a default icon of a distinct shape and a screen-reader-only category prefix ("Warning: " and so on, per locale); neutral has no category and neither. Removing the icon does not remove the prefix.

props.name: icon
props.description: 类别图标。省略时 info、warning、danger、success 各有形状不同的默认图标（圆、三角、八角、圆加勾），neutral 没有；传节点则替换；false 不放图标。
props.descriptionEn: Category icon. Omitted: info, warning, danger and success each get a default icon of a different shape (circle, triangle, octagon, circle with check); neutral has none. A node replaces it; false places no icon.

props.name: role
props.description: 仅确有宣告需求时由调用方显式传入。
props.descriptionEn: The caller supplies these only when an announcement is needed.

api.name: AlertDescription

api.descriptionEn: In-place explanatory text that permits long content to wrap.

components.name: alert-dialog
components.title: 决定对话框 AlertDialog
components.description: 阻断整个工作面，要求对当前对象作出明确选择。
notes: 普通编辑使用 Dialog；不需要中断时用就地确认或面板。
后果必须在对话框里可见（Description）；说明较长时放进 AlertDialogPanel，页眉与页脚固定，只有它滚动。
关闭与继续动作分别处理。
必须提供明确的返回选择，不能只依赖 Esc。
共享层级按真实开启顺序使新工作面高于旧面候选；调用方覆盖 zIndex 可破坏默认关系。
ARIA实测驱动的契约收窄：Portal固定keepMounted=false，JS传true也不保留关闭DOM。应用显式持有草稿；Primitive自行组合未修复该原语缺陷。

en.title: AlertDialog
en.description: Block the work surface for an explicit decision about the current object.
en.decisions: Backdrop presses do not dismiss it; focus starts on the panel. Escape and the return button only close the dialog. The caller handles the affirmative action.
notes: Use Dialog for ordinary edits, or inline confirmation when interruption is unnecessary.
Keep the consequence visible in the dialog (Description); put long explanations in AlertDialogPanel so the header and footer stay fixed and only it scrolls.
Handle closing and the affirmative action separately.
Provide an explicit return choice; Escape alone is insufficient.
Shared layers put a newly opened surface above older owned popups. Caller zIndex overrides can break that relationship.
ARIA evidence narrows the contract: Portal forces keepMounted=false, even for JavaScript callers passing true. The application holds drafts explicitly; direct Primitive composition remains affected.

components.name: async-content
components.title: 异步内容 AsyncContent
components.description: 分别呈现请求状态与仍然有效的内容。
notes: error 状态的反馈由组件包在 role=alert 里宣告，errorContent 不必再自带 role=alert（嵌套会重复播报）；有效内容不设为 live region。
反馈固定排在内容之后：刷新与失败时正在阅读的内容不被推动，只有其后的元素随反馈占位而移动。
hasContent 表示当前可呈现的内容，不等同于曾经成功过；筛选范围或权限变化后，由应用判断旧内容是否仍有效。

api.descriptionEn: A content-state composition that makes no requests.

props.description: 应用声明请求事实，不用超时猜测失败。

props.description: 有效内容保持挂载；不会自动禁用、清空草稿或移动焦点。
props.descriptionEn: Valid content stays mounted without automatic disabling, draft clearing or focus movement.

props.name: emptyContent / loadingContent / errorContent
props.description: emptyContent 必填；error 状态必须提供 errorContent。加载默认读 locale。重试动作由应用提供。
props.descriptionEn: emptyContent is required; error requires errorContent. Loading defaults to the locale. The app supplies retry actions.

props.name: render / ref / native props
props.description: 实际根节点的语义与属性；根节点本身不是 live region，只有 error 反馈带 role=alert。

en.title: AsyncContent
en.description: Present request status separately from content that remains valid.
en.decisions: status describes the latest request; hasContent says whether existing content is still valid. Initial loading has no content; refresh and refresh failure retain content and component identity. Only success with hasContent=false shows an empty state. Applications must remove content if a permission change invalidates it.
notes: Error feedback is wrapped in role=alert by the component, so errorContent need not add its own (nesting announces twice); retained content is never made live.
Feedback always follows the content: refresh and failure do not push the content being read, only elements after it move with the feedback.
hasContent means content is currently usable, not that a past request once succeeded. The app re-evaluates validity after scope or permission changes.

notes: 库显示对象版本而不推断新旧；应用在执行边界复核实际版本。

api.name: BulkActionBar
api.description: 可识别的作用对象与范围。
api.descriptionEn: Identifiable operation targets and scope.

props.name: targets / scope
props.description: 每项 id/label/version 必填，id 唯一；version=0 合法；scope 非空。
props.descriptionEn: Each target requires id, label and version; IDs are unique, version=0 is valid and scope is nonempty.

props.name: extent
props.description: 应用定义的整个集合（count 为正整数、label 非空）；显示计数与 label 而不列对象，targets 可为空，快照带 extent，由应用按自己持有的查询执行。
props.descriptionEn: An application-defined whole set (positive integer count, nonempty label); shows count and label instead of listing targets, targets may be empty, and the snapshot carries extent for the application to execute against its own query.

props.name: sticky
props.description: 吸附在最近的滚动容器顶端（Workspace 中为 WorkspaceContent），不能放进带 overflow 的中间容器；吸住且有内容滚过时才出现分界线（data-stuck）。
props.descriptionEn: Sticks to the nearest scroll container (WorkspaceContent in a Workspace); do not place it inside an intermediate overflow container. The divider appears only while stuck with content scrolling beneath (data-stuck).

props.name: disabled / onClear
props.description: 清除收到当前快照，不取消服务或自行清空应用状态。
props.descriptionEn: Clear receives the current snapshot; it never cancels a service or clears application state itself.

props.name: render / ref / native props
props.description: 属性和 ref 归属实际元素；调用方事件与样式保留。
props.descriptionEn: Props and refs target actual elements; caller events and styles are preserved.

api.name: BulkActionBarExtend
api.description: 把本页选择扩展为整个集合的入口；仅在调用方渲染时出现，不推断是否还有更多。
api.descriptionEn: Entry that extends the page selection to the whole set; it appears only when rendered and never infers whether more exist.

props.name: count / onExtend
props.description: 默认文字「选择全部 N 项」，数字按界面语言分组；onClick.preventDefault() 取消。
props.descriptionEn: Default text is Select all N items with locale-grouped digits; onClick.preventDefault() cancels.

props.name: onExecute
props.description: onClick.preventDefault() 取消；危险操作需另外提供后果保护。

components.description: 触发有明确对象与后果的动作；状态由调用方持有。
notes: 危险色调只是色调，不代表授权，也不替代确认；需要用户知道后果再决定时用 AlertDialog。
忙碌时动作的可访问名称不变；「进行中」通过 description 与不可见的 live region 告诉读屏，按钮旁没有可见的状态文字。忙碌不改变按钮的外缘尺寸：名称与图形留在原处占位（不可见，仍在无障碍树里），转动的记号叠放在中央。
state（waiting / in-progress / unknown / failed）已移除，改为 loading。原来写在按钮旁的失败与结果未知，改由 Alert、Toast、FieldError 或 StatusDot 表达。
导航使用原生 a / Link + buttonVariants；nativeButton=false 的 Button 仍是命令语义。
小控件通过 touch-target 扩大命中区到本库 44px 目标，密度与外观尺寸不改变这一目标。
实心入口与父表面对比不足时，消费组合通过 className 添加可辨认边界，并使用同档 padding-bordered；同底色边界示例展示这一入口，组件不读取 DOM 推断承载面。

props.description: 色调。danger 表示动作有不可逆的后果，只改变颜色；后果说明与确认不由按钮承载，用 AlertDialog 或 ConfirmAction。
props.descriptionEn: Tone. danger marks an action with an irreversible consequence and changes color only; the consequence text and confirmation are not carried by the button. Use AlertDialog or ConfirmAction.

props.description: 按所在位置选尺寸，与强调独立。
props.descriptionEn: Choose by position, independently of emphasis.

en.title: Button
en.description: Trigger a named action with a clear object and consequence. The caller owns its state.
en.decisions: A button only triggers an action, and busy is its only state: while busy it retains focus and blocks repeated activation. Success, failure and an unknown result are separate facts expressed by feedback components (Alert in place, Toast for brief feedback, FieldError for a field); consequences and confirmation belong to AlertDialog. Tone never grants permission.
notes: Danger is only a tone: it grants no permission and replaces no confirmation. Use AlertDialog when the user must know the consequence before deciding.

While busy the action's accessible name stays unchanged; “In progress” reaches screen readers through a description and an invisible live region, and no visible status text sits beside the button. Busy never changes the button's outer size: the name or glyph keeps its place, unseen but still in the accessibility tree, and the spinning mark is centered over it.

state (waiting / in-progress / unknown / failed) is removed in favour of loading. Failure and unknown results formerly written beside the button are expressed by Alert, Toast, FieldError or StatusDot.
Use a native anchor or router Link with buttonVariants for navigation. A nativeButton=false Button remains a command.
touch-target expands small controls to the library's 44px touch target without changing visual dimensions or shrinking it with density.

When a solid action lacks contrast with its parent, the consumer adds a visible boundary through className and uses the matching padding-bordered profile. The same-surface example demonstrates this entry; the component does not inspect the DOM to infer its surface.

methods: Complementary roles and safeguards （相成相制）
whenToUse: Run a command with an object and consequence, submit a form, or stop the current task.
avoid: Use native links for navigation.
Writing the result into the button: the end of busy does not establish success; express failure and unknown results with Alert, Toast or FieldError.
composition: For an irreversible action the button is only the entry: it opens AlertDialog (or ConfirmAction), whose description states the consequence. Applications own confirmation criteria, permissions, and remote verification.
A two-state fact that persists after pressing (selected, on) is a Toggle; one of several is SegmentedControl, several of several is ToggleGroup. Button triggers an action and holds no selection.

application: Objects, scope, consequences, permissions, request facts, verification, recovery, and background cancellation.

responsive: Choose dimensions for position; long labels may wrap and grow, icons retain matching geometry, and touch targets remain separate from appearance.
customization: variant, tone, size, and shape independently select presentation, consequence, dimensions, and content form.

components.name: cascader
components.title: 级联选择 Cascader
components.description: 沿「根到叶」的路径选一个值，每一级的候选各占一列。
notes: 触发器的文字是完整路径，过长时用省略号截断，完整文字仍在 DOM 里，读屏读到全部。
鼠标点父项只展开；selectParent 时父项同时成为值，弹层保持打开以便继续往下选。键盘上这是两个键：Enter 提交并关闭，→ 展开。
焦点是真实 DOM 焦点（roving tabindex），每列是一个 listbox，名称是它的父项，第一列取触发器的名称。搜索结果例外：焦点留在输入里，用 aria-activedescendant。
选项上的 aria-haspopup 与 aria-expanded 表示「有下一列」与「下一列已展开」。
候选的可见字号与高度与 Select 的候选项相同；每列宽度由内容决定，下限由留白、尾部标记与最小文字区推出，列多时候选面横向滚动。

api.name: Cascader
api.description: 触发器、列式候选面与表单值。触发器与 Select 同一套几何；候选面用 Popover 的面板。
api.descriptionEn: Trigger, column-wise candidate popup and form value. The trigger shares Select's geometry; the popup uses Popover's panel.

props.name: options
props.description: 第一列的候选。节点 { value, label, disabled?, children?, isLeaf? }：同一父项下 value 不重复；有 children 的是分支，没有则是叶子（配了 loadChildren 时除外）。
props.descriptionEn: Candidates of the first column. A node is { value, label, disabled?, children?, isLeaf? }; values are unique under one parent. A node with children is a branch, otherwise a leaf (unless loadChildren is set).

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: 从根到所选节点的路径，null 是未选择；省略初值不会选第一项。路径里尚未加载的节点，触发器退回显示它的 value。
props.descriptionEn: The path from the root to the chosen node; null is no selection, and omitting an initial value does not choose the first item. A path segment that is not loaded yet falls back to its value in the trigger.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: 提交了新的路径时调用；第二个参数是路径上各节点。提交相同路径不调用。
props.descriptionEn: Called when a new path is submitted; the second argument is the nodes on the path. Submitting the same path does not call it.

props.name: selectParent
props.description: 默认只有叶子可提交；true 时任意层级都可提交（对应 Ant Design 的 changeOnSelect）。
props.descriptionEn: Only leaves submit by default; with true any level can submit (Ant Design's changeOnSelect).

props.name: loadChildren
props.description: 展开一个没有 children、也没有标 isLeaf 的节点时调用。等待时该列显示「正在加载」，reject 时显示「加载失败」与重试；结果为空数组则该节点成为叶子。结果按路径缓存，组件不重复请求。
props.descriptionEn: Called when a node with neither children nor isLeaf is expanded. While waiting the column shows "Loading"; a rejection shows "Failed to load" with a retry; an empty result makes the node a leaf. Results are cached by path and not requested twice.

props.name: searchable
props.description: 弹层顶部出现搜索输入；有输入时改为一列扁平的匹配路径（用 locale 的路径分隔符连接）。只搜已知节点，未加载的分支不在其中。
props.descriptionEn: A search input appears at the top of the popup; with input the columns give way to one flat list of matching paths joined by the locale separator. Only known nodes are searched, so unloaded branches are not included.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: 仅未选择时显示；不能替代 FieldLabel。
props.descriptionEn: Shown only without selection; cannot replace FieldLabel.

props.name: disabled / readOnly / required
props.description: 只读保留当前值且不打开候选面；禁用的字段不提交；required 参与原生校验并标 aria-required。invalid 跟随 Field。
props.descriptionEn: Read-only keeps the value and never opens the popup; a disabled field is not submitted; required joins native validation and sets aria-required. invalid follows Field.

props.name: name / form
props.description: 隐藏输入的名称与所属表单。提交值是路径各段用 "/" 连接，例如 "zj/hz/xh"，未选择提交空字符串；所以 value 里不应含 "/"。
props.descriptionEn: Name and owning form of the hidden input. The submitted value is the path segments joined with "/", such as "zj/hz/xh"; an empty string when nothing is selected. Values should therefore not contain "/".

props.name: aria-label / aria-labelledby / id / className
props.description: 触发器的名称与样式入口。没有名称会抛错：用 aria-label、aria-labelledby，或放进带 FieldLabel 的 Field。
props.descriptionEn: Name and styling entries of the trigger. A missing name throws: use aria-label, aria-labelledby, or place it in a Field with a FieldLabel.

components.decisions: 选择的是一条路径，不是最后一项：同名的叶子（不同省的「市辖区」）靠路径区分，所以值、表单与回调都用路径。分支能不能提交由 selectParent 决定，而不是看有没有子项；加载与失败是应用告知之外、组件自己看得见的事实，不会被当成「没有子项」。

en.title: Cascader
en.description: Choose one value along a root-to-leaf path, with each level's candidates in its own column.
en.decisions: What is chosen is a path, not the last node: leaves with the same name (a "city district" in different provinces) are told apart by their path, so the value, the form and the callback all use the path. Whether a branch can be submitted is decided by selectParent, not by whether it has children; loading and failure are facts the component sees for itself and are never taken for "no children".
notes: The trigger text is the complete path, truncated with an ellipsis when long; the full text stays in the DOM so assistive technology reads all of it.

A mouse click on a parent only expands it; with selectParent the parent also becomes the value and the popup stays open so you can continue downward. On the keyboard these are two keys: Enter submits and closes, → expands.

Focus is real DOM focus (roving tabindex). Each column is a listbox named by its parent; the first column takes the trigger's name. Search results are the exception: focus stays in the input and aria-activedescendant points at the result.
aria-haspopup and aria-expanded on an option mean "has a next column" and "the next column is open".

Candidates share Select's text size and height. Column width follows content with a lower bound derived from padding, trailing marker and minimum text area; the popup scrolls horizontally when columns are many.

components.name: chart
components.title: 图表 Chart
components.description: 九种由任务选定的形式——折线、柱状、面积、堆叠面积、占比面积、横向柱、堆叠柱、占比柱、环形；同源的图形、命名的轴与按需展开的数据表。
notes: 系列的区分不只靠色相：折线的每个系列有自己的标记形状（圆、方、三角、菱形、叉，按系列顺序分配），图例的键与折线一致，图例文字、悬停读数和数据表里都有系列名。柱、堆叠与面积是填充形式，靠固定的系列顺序区分——图例、柱的左右次序、堆叠的上下次序、读数与数据表同一个次序，段间有 2px 纸色空隙；这类图不另加纹理。
没有记录时 Chart 抛错而不画空框。请求中的图用 AsyncContent 组合：先判空再渲染，`<AsyncContent status hasContent={rows.length > 0} emptyContent={<Empty />}>` 里只放 Chart，空结果由 Empty 在原位承担，加载与失败的反馈在内容之后；见「请求状态与空结果」。
null、NaN、Infinity、缺失键不能表示0；用显式unknown或not-applicable表达。
所有值均未知时不画虚假数值轴，名称、图例与表格保留。
默认图形为数据表的视觉补充，辅助技术使用展开后的数据表；悬停读数只增强，不替代数据表。
长名称在可见Table保留，图形轴的公共碰撞处理不表示记录丢失。
浅深必要图形对真实背景至少3:1、文字至少4.5:1，由浏览器owner核实。
折线上相邻两点的间距小于两个标记宽（16px）时，每个系列只画最后一个已知点的标记，形状照旧；点距足够时每点都画。
状态色（tone）之外必须另有名称、位置或数值承担同一事实：浅色主题下危险与警示的明度相近，红绿色觉缺陷下相邻时不易分辨，堆叠段之间 2px 的纸色空隙、图例次序、读数与数据表里的名称是兜底。
堆叠与占比的读数末尾与数据表末列给出「合计」；行内有未知或不适用值时不合计（已知部分的和不是合计），读数记「—」，数据表写明缺项。
环形图例每项给出名称、值与占比（含总量大于各部分之和时的「其余」），数值列右对齐并用等宽数字，写法与 Proportion 的图例一致。
donut 超过5个部分或需要精确比较时改用 Proportion 或 bar/bar-horizontal；两个量的关系用 ScatterChart，两个类别维度上的量用 Heatmap——它们数据形状不同，是独立组件而不是 Chart 的 type。

props.descriptionEn: A nonempty semantic name for the actual data.

props.name: framed
props.description: false：图放在已有的面上（无边框的 Section、Card、面板），不铺自己的纸——没有线、底、圆角与内缘，图的左右缘就是承载面的内容缘。与 TableContainer 的 framed 同义。是否显示图内标题与它无关。
props.descriptionEn: false: the chart sits on an existing surface (a borderless Section, Card or panel) and lays no paper of its own — no line, fill, radius or inner padding, so its edges are the host's content edges. Same meaning as TableContainer's framed. Whether the in-chart title shows is independent of it.

props.name: aria-labelledby / aria-label
props.description: 外部名称：传入非空的 aria-labelledby（如 SectionTitle 的 id）或 aria-label 时，figure 由它命名，图内不显示标题；图例与「查看数据」仍在图内、靠行尾，二者都没有时标题栏整行不渲染。不传时由图内标题命名。label 仍必填，是等价数据表的名字。
props.descriptionEn: Outside name: a nonempty aria-labelledby (such as a SectionTitle id) or aria-label names the figure and the in-chart title is not drawn; the legend and Show data stay inside the figure at the row end, and with neither the header row is not rendered. Without one the in-chart title names it. label stays required and names the equivalent data table.

props.name: type
props.description: 由任务选定的形式，不是外观偏好：line 随时间/次序的趋势；bar 类别间比较；area 随时间的量（单系列第一色淡面，多系列默认半透叠放）；area-stacked 随时间的构成（淡色带加足色上沿，彼此相切）；bar-horizontal 类别名长或按大小排序的排行；bar-stacked 类别间的构成比较；bar-share / area-share 构成的占比怎样变（各行归一到该行之和，量轴固定 0–100%，原值与占比同时在读数与数据表里；两个以上系列，值不得为负；含未知 / 不适用值或和为 0 的行不画，已知原值在数据表里如实列出；不接受 references 与 valueDomain）；donut 只用于 2–5 个部分、一眼占比的单个整体（rows 必须正好一行）。必填。
props.descriptionEn: The form chosen by the task, not an appearance preference: line for trends over time/order; bar for category comparison; area for a quantity over time (a first-color wash for one series, translucent overlap by default for several); area-stacked for composition over time (opaque light bands with full-color top edges, touching); bar-horizontal for long category names or size-ordered rankings; bar-stacked for composition comparison between categories; bar-share / area-share for how the share of a composition changes (each row is normalised to its own sum on a fixed 0–100% axis, with original value and share together in the readout and table; two or more series, no negative values; a row with an unknown / not-applicable value or a sum of zero is not drawn while its known original values stay in the data table; references and valueDomain are not accepted); donut only for an at-a-glance share of 2–5 parts in a single whole (rows must be exactly one). Required.

props.name: categoryLabel / valueLabel
props.description: 非空分类轴名与共享量纲/单位；donut 不画轴线，但两个名字仍用于等价数据表与中心读数的说明文字。
props.descriptionEn: Nonempty category axis name and shared value units; donut draws no axis lines, but both names still label the equivalent table and the center readout.

props.name: series
props.type: readonly { key: string; label: string; context?: boolean; tone?: Tone; interpolation?: "linear" | "step" }[]
props.description: 1至5个同量纲系列（donut 要求2至5个；背景系列不计入）。context: true 只用于 line，画成淡墨细线、不画标记、不占身份色与标记名额，另限 12 条；tone 取 danger / warning / success / info，全部非背景系列都声明或都不声明，同一类别不得重复（混用、重复抛错）。interpolation 取 linear（默认）或 step（阶梯，step-after：值从该点起保持到下一点），只对 line、area、area-stacked、area-share 生效，其他类型传入抛错；堆叠与占比的面各带共用边界，必须同一种。只有一个系列时取第一色（文字是墨，数据是色）、不显示图例；两个以上按 chart1..5 的校验顺序取色，并配不同标记形状或图例方块。
props.descriptionEn: One to five series in shared units (donut requires two to five; context series do not count). context: true is for line only: a faint ink hairline with no marker that takes no identity color or marker slot, at most 12; tone takes danger / warning / success / info, declared on every non-context series or none, with no repeated category (mixing or repeating throws). interpolation is linear (default) or step (a staircase, step-after: the value is held from that point to the next) and applies to line, area, area-stacked and area-share only, any other type throws; stacked and share areas share their boundaries, so every series must use the same one. A single series takes the first color (text is ink, data is color) without a legend; two or more take the validated chart1..5 order with distinct marker shapes or legend swatches.

props.name: rows
props.description: 稳定id、分类名称与values；值为finite number或{state:unknown|not-applicable,label}。必须有真实记录；donut 要求正好一行，且每个部分必须是已知的非负数。
props.descriptionEn: Stable ids, category names and values: finite numbers or explicitly named unknown/not-applicable values. ready requires actual records; donut requires exactly one row, with every part a known non-negative number.

props.name: contextLabel
props.description: 有背景系列时必填：图例里合成一项的名字（淡墨线键 + 此名），例如「其余蚕室」。背景系列各自的名字只出现在等价数据表。缺失抛错。
props.descriptionEn: Required when there are context series: the one legend entry that stands for them (a faint ink key plus this name), e.g. "Other rooms". Their individual names appear only in the equivalent table. Throws when missing.

props.name: references
props.type: ({ kind: "band"; from: number; to: number; label: string } | { kind: "line"; value: number; label: string })[]
props.description: 量轴上的参照：目标带或参照线（纵向图是横带 / 横线，bar-horizontal 是竖带 / 竖线）。画成墨、在数据之后；量轴范围自动算入；label 必填，出现在图例与数据表下的表注；band 须 from < to，数值有限；donut 传入抛错。有带时悬停读数为每个数值多一行相对目标的位置（高于、低于多少，或在内）；多个带时只对第一个计算。
props.descriptionEn: References on the value axis: a target band or a reference line (horizontal for vertical charts, vertical for bar-horizontal). Drawn in ink behind the data; the value axis range includes them automatically. label is required and appears in the legend and in a note under the data table; a band needs from < to and finite values; a donut throws. With a band, the hover readout adds a line per value for its position against the target (above or below by how much, or within); with several bands only the first is used.

props.name: events
props.type: readonly { rowId: string; label: string; tone?: Tone }[]
props.description: 落在类别轴某一行上的事件：基线处一个圆点（给 tone 时用类别色，否则用墨）。事件名出现在该行的悬停读数，并作为数据表的「事件」一列。rowId 不存在或 donut 传入抛错。
props.descriptionEn: Events on a row of the category axis: a dot on the baseline (category color when tone is given, ink otherwise). The label appears in that row's hover readout and as an "Event" column of the data table. A missing rowId, or a donut, throws.

props.name: valueDomain
props.description: 量轴范围，只对 line 生效：位置编码可以不从零起，例如 80%–100% 的比率。其他类型传入即抛 RangeError（柱与面积用长度、面积编码，必须从零起）。min < max；任何已知值或参照落在范围外抛错——截掉数据与名实不符。刻度取 1、2、2.5、5 乘 10 的幂，最多 6 个。
props.descriptionEn: Value axis range, for line only: position encoding may leave zero, e.g. a ratio from 80% to 100%. Any other type throws a RangeError (bars and areas encode by length or area and must start at zero). min < max; a known value or reference outside the range throws, since cutting data off misstates it. Ticks are 1, 2, 2.5 or 5 times a power of ten, at most six.

props.name: total
props.description: 只用于 donut：整体的总量。省略时等于各部分之和；大于之和时，剩余部分并入「其余」（groove-surface，不是第六种色相）。
props.descriptionEn: Donut only: the whole's total. Defaults to the sum of its parts; a larger value folds the remainder into a neutral "rest" slice (groove-surface, not a sixth hue).

props.name: valueLabels
props.description: 把格式化后的值标在柱的数据端外侧（纵柱在柱顶上方，横柱在末端之后，负值在另一侧）；同时不再画量轴刻度与网格，基线保留。只对 bar 与 bar-horizontal 生效，且只允许单系列、至多 12 行（每根柱的类别带得放得下一个标签）；其他类型、多系列或行数超出抛错。文字用墨阶、dense 档、等宽数字；formatValue 只取字符串或数字结果，返回节点时退回默认数值格式。
props.descriptionEn: Put the formatted value just outside the data end of each bar (above a vertical bar, after the end of a horizontal one, on the other side for negative values); value-axis ticks and grid are then no longer drawn and the baseline stays. Only for bar and bar-horizontal, a single series and at most 12 rows (each category band must hold a label); any other type, several series or more rows throws. Text is ink, dense step, tabular figures; formatValue is read for strings or numbers only and falls back to the default number format when it returns a node.

props.name: formatValue
props.description: 格式化已知数值；默认按UILocale数值Intl，不改数据。合计、环形图例的数值与「其余」按第一个系列调用（堆叠与环形的系列共用一个量纲）；占比读数、柱上标值、环形图例只取字符串或数字结果。
props.descriptionEn: Format known values without changing data. Defaults to Intl number formatting for UILocale. Totals, donut legend values and the remainder call it with the first series (stacked and donut series share one unit); share readouts, value labels and the donut legend read strings or numbers only.

props.name: renderPlot
props.description: 替换同源图形；gap为null，默认LineChart不连接gap且不动画。名称、图例与可见Table始终保留。自定义图形承担自身交互/ARIA；projection 带有 references、events、valueDomain，系列带 context 与 tone，自定义图形应一并遵守（背景系列不画标记，参照画在数据后面）。
props.descriptionEn: Replace the same-source plot. Gaps project to null; the default LineChart neither connects gaps nor animates. Names, legend and visible Table remain. Custom plots own their interaction and ARIA; the projection carries references, events and valueDomain, and series carry context and tone, which a custom plot should honor (no markers on context series, references behind the data).

props.name: style / className / render / ref
props.description: 根style可覆写 --qy-chart-plot-height（默认 10 材）。线宽、标记与柱宽是图的法度，不开放逐个配置。
props.descriptionEn: Root style may override --qy-chart-plot-height (default 10 modules). Line width, markers and bar width are fixed by the chart's rules rather than configured individually.

构成占比随时间：占比面积

读准确值：横向柱标值

请求状态与空结果

whenToUse: 真实共享量纲数据需要图形比较，且等价值可达。
读者要知道「在不在范围内」：用 references 给目标带或参照线，不要靠网格线猜。
一个量要放在同类的“其余”里读：把其余几条设为背景系列（context），只有关注的一条取色。
数据的变化有已知的原因：用 events 在类别轴上标出，名称进读数与数据表。
折线读的是窄区间内的变化（比率 80%–100%）：用 valueDomain；柱与面积不行。
系列本身就是状态类别（成功、重试、失败）：用 tone，由应用声明哪个系列是哪一类，组件不从数值猜好坏。
值在两次变化之间保持不变（设定值、阈值、库存）：用 interpolation: "step"，不要用直线编造中间值。
读的是构成怎样变而不是多少：bar-share（各类别）、area-share（随时间），原值与占比同时在读数与数据表里。
柱少而要读准确值：用 valueLabels 把数标在柱上，不再画刻度与网格。
切换时间范围或指标：不加接口——把范围放在应用的状态里，用 SegmentedControl 选择，Chart 只按它换 rows。
avoid: 混合量纲、猜测结果、把缺值连成可靠趋势或仅靠颜色。
环形超过5个部分，或占比需要精确比较而不是一眼大小。
把柱或面积的量轴截断（valueDomain 对它们抛错）。
用参照、背景线或事件点承载唯一的数据：它们是墨、是背景，数值读数在数据表里。
tone 与按次序取色的系列混用，或两个系列同一类别。
用平滑曲线连接两点（不提供：曲线画出数据里没有的值）；用占比图读绝对量；把值标在堆叠段或多系列并排的柱上（段太窄、标签挤成一片，valueLabels 不接受）。
composition: Recharts公开原语 + 当前Table；同一rows/series投影。没有可画的数据时，调用方在原位改放 Empty。

library: 同源投影、可见等价表、系列形态和基础名称。
application: 数据、量纲、真实性、状态文字与自定义图形。

responsive: 图高集中12em可覆写，表格原生滚动/换行；不裁掉实际值。
customization: chart1..5语义角色；局部plot roles与公开renderPlot，不另造图表调色板。系列颜色按次序取，次序是色觉安全的机制，不开放自由配色；状态色只有 danger / warning / success / info 四类。

components.decisions: 图只画数据。已知0、未知和不适用的单个值分别成立：未知值形成gap，表格保留其真实名称。整张图没有记录、结果未知或不适用时不渲染图，由调用方在原位放 Empty。图形不替代可达数值。参照（目标带、参照线）、背景系列与事件只帮读者定位数据，自己不是数据：用墨不用色，名称必填并出现在图例与数据表。量轴只有折线可以不从零起，柱与面积的长度、面积编码一旦截断，比例就是假的。状态色（series[].tone）由应用声明，组件不从数值猜好坏。阶梯（series[].interpolation: "step"）表达值在两次变化之间保持不变，取 step-after：记录是「这一刻起变成了这个值」，step-before 会把变化画到观测之前；不提供平滑曲线，曲线在两点之间画出数据里没有的值。占比构成（bar-share / area-share）读的是构成怎样变而不是多少：各行内归一到该行之和，量轴固定 0–100%，刻度 0/25/50/75/100；含未知或不适用值、或和为 0 的行整行不画（整体不可得，每一部分的占比都会是假的），已知原值在数据表里如实列出；负值抛错。柱上标值（valueLabels）只给单系列的 bar 与 bar-horizontal，标了值就不再画量轴刻度与网格（同一事实不说两遍）。堆叠与占比的读数和数据表给出合计；含缺项的行不合计，数据表里写明缺项。

en.title: Chart
en.description: Nine task-chosen forms—line, bar, area, area-stacked, area-share, bar-horizontal, bar-stacked, bar-share and donut—with a same-source plot, named axes and an on-demand data table.
en.decisions: A chart only draws data. A known zero, an unknown value and a not-applicable value remain distinct: unavailable values form gaps and retain their actual names in the table. When the whole chart has no records, an unknown result or does not apply, the chart is not rendered and the caller puts Empty in its place. Plots do not replace reachable numbers. References (target bands and lines), context series and events help locate the data without being data: they are ink, not color, and their names are required and appear in the legend and the data table. Only a line may leave zero on the value axis; bars and areas encode by length or area, so truncating them misstates proportions. Status colors (series[].tone) are declared by the application; the component never guesses good from bad by value. A step (series[].interpolation: "step") says the value is held between two changes and is step-after: a record means "from this moment the value is this", and step-before would draw the change before it was observed; there are no smooth curves, which draw values the data does not contain. Share composition (bar-share / area-share) reads how a composition changes rather than how much: each row is normalised to its own sum, the value axis is fixed at 0–100% with ticks 0/25/50/75/100; a row with an unknown or not-applicable value, or a sum of zero, is not drawn at all (the whole is unavailable, so every share would be false) while its known original values stay in the data table; negative values throw. Value labels (valueLabels) are for single-series bar and bar-horizontal only, and once values are labelled the value-axis ticks and grid are no longer drawn (one fact is not said twice). Readouts and tables of stacked and share forms give a total; a row with a missing part is not totaled and the table says so.
notes: Series are told apart by more than hue: each line series has its own marker shape (circle, square, triangle, diamond, cross, assigned in series order), the legend key matches the line, and the series name appears in the legend text, the hover readout and the data table. Bars, stacks and areas are filled forms and rely on a fixed series order: the legend, the left-to-right order of bars, the bottom-to-top order of stacks, the readout and the data table all share one order, with a 2px paper gap between segments; no texture is added to them.

With no rows Chart throws instead of drawing an empty frame. For a chart behind a request, compose it with AsyncContent and test emptiness first: `<AsyncContent status hasContent={rows.length > 0} emptyContent={<Empty />}>` holds only the Chart, an empty result is carried by Empty in its place, and loading or failure feedback follows the content; see "Request states and empty results".
null, NaN, Infinity and missing keys cannot stand for zero. Use explicit unknown or not-applicable values.
When every value is unavailable, no fabricated numeric axis is drawn; names, legend and table remain.
The default plot supplements the data table, which provides assistive access once expanded; hover readouts enhance but never replace it.
The visible Table retains full names. Axis collision handling does not mean records are missing.
The browser owner verifies light/dark contrast: necessary graphics at least 3:1 against the actual background and text at least 4.5:1.
When neighboring points on a line are closer than two marker widths (16px), only the last known point of each series keeps its marker, with its shape unchanged; with enough room every point is drawn.

A status color (tone) must be backed by a name, position or value that carries the same fact: in the light theme danger and warning have similar lightness and are hard to tell apart under red-green color deficiency when adjacent, so the 2px paper gap between stacked segments, the legend order, and the names in the readout and data table are the fallback.

Readouts of stacked and share forms end with a Total, and so does the data table; a row with an unknown or not-applicable value is not totaled (the sum of the known parts is not a total): the readout shows an em dash and the table says a part is missing.

Each donut legend entry gives name, value and share (including the remainder when the total exceeds the sum of the parts); the value column is right-aligned with tabular figures and written as in the Proportion legend.

Past five donut parts, or when precise comparison matters, use Proportion or bar/bar-horizontal instead. The relationship between two quantities is ScatterChart; a quantity over two categorical dimensions is Heatmap — both have a different data shape and are separate components, not a Chart type.

api.name: Chart
api.description: A named figure, shared axis units, distinct series shapes and a visible same-source Table.
api.descriptionEn: A named figure, shared axis units, distinct series shapes and a visible same-source Table.

props.name: label
props.description: A nonempty semantic name for the actual data.
props.descriptionEn: A nonempty semantic name for the actual data.

props.name: framed
props.description: false: the chart sits on an existing surface (a borderless Section, Card or panel) and lays no paper of its own — no line, fill, radius or inner padding, so its edges are the host's content edges. Same meaning as TableContainer's framed. Whether the in-chart title shows is independent of it.
props.descriptionEn: false: the chart sits on an existing surface (a borderless Section, Card or panel) and lays no paper of its own — no line, fill, radius or inner padding, so its edges are the host's content edges. Same meaning as TableContainer's framed. Whether the in-chart title shows is independent of it.

props.name: aria-labelledby / aria-label
props.description: Outside name: a nonempty aria-labelledby (such as a SectionTitle id) or aria-label names the figure and the in-chart title is not drawn; the legend and Show data stay inside the figure at the row end, and with neither the header row is not rendered. Without one the in-chart title names it. label stays required and names the equivalent data table.
props.descriptionEn: Outside name: a nonempty aria-labelledby (such as a SectionTitle id) or aria-label names the figure and the in-chart title is not drawn; the legend and Show data stay inside the figure at the row end, and with neither the header row is not rendered. Without one the in-chart title names it. label stays required and names the equivalent data table.

props.name: type
props.description: The form chosen by the task, not an appearance preference: line for trends over time/order; bar for category comparison; area for a quantity over time (a first-color wash for one series, translucent overlap by default for several); area-stacked for composition over time (opaque light bands with full-color top edges, touching); bar-horizontal for long category names or size-ordered rankings; bar-stacked for composition comparison between categories; bar-share / area-share for how the share of a composition changes (each row is normalised to its own sum on a fixed 0–100% axis, with original value and share together in the readout and table; two or more series, no negative values; a row with an unknown / not-applicable value or a sum of zero is not drawn while its known original values stay in the data table; references and valueDomain are not accepted); donut only for an at-a-glance share of 2–5 parts in a single whole (rows must be exactly one). Required.
props.descriptionEn: The form chosen by the task, not an appearance preference: line for trends over time/order; bar for category comparison; area for a quantity over time (a first-color wash for one series, translucent overlap by default for several); area-stacked for composition over time (opaque light bands with full-color top edges, touching); bar-horizontal for long category names or size-ordered rankings; bar-stacked for composition comparison between categories; bar-share / area-share for how the share of a composition changes (each row is normalised to its own sum on a fixed 0–100% axis, with original value and share together in the readout and table; two or more series, no negative values; a row with an unknown / not-applicable value or a sum of zero is not drawn while its known original values stay in the data table; references and valueDomain are not accepted); donut only for an at-a-glance share of 2–5 parts in a single whole (rows must be exactly one). Required.

props.name: categoryLabel / valueLabel
props.description: Nonempty category axis name and shared value units; donut draws no axis lines, but both names still label the equivalent table and the center readout.
props.descriptionEn: Nonempty category axis name and shared value units; donut draws no axis lines, but both names still label the equivalent table and the center readout.

props.name: series
props.type: readonly { key: string; label: string; context?: boolean; tone?: Tone; interpolation?: "linear" | "step" }[]
props.description: One to five series in shared units (donut requires two to five; context series do not count). context: true is for line only: a faint ink hairline with no marker that takes no identity color or marker slot, at most 12; tone takes danger / warning / success / info, declared on every non-context series or none, with no repeated category (mixing or repeating throws). interpolation is linear (default) or step (a staircase, step-after: the value is held from that point to the next) and applies to line, area, area-stacked and area-share only, any other type throws; stacked and share areas share their boundaries, so every series must use the same one. A single series takes the first color (text is ink, data is color) without a legend; two or more take the validated chart1..5 order with distinct marker shapes or legend swatches.
props.descriptionEn: One to five series in shared units (donut requires two to five; context series do not count). context: true is for line only: a faint ink hairline with no marker that takes no identity color or marker slot, at most 12; tone takes danger / warning / success / info, declared on every non-context series or none, with no repeated category (mixing or repeating throws). interpolation is linear (default) or step (a staircase, step-after: the value is held from that point to the next) and applies to line, area, area-stacked and area-share only, any other type throws; stacked and share areas share their boundaries, so every series must use the same one. A single series takes the first color (text is ink, data is color) without a legend; two or more take the validated chart1..5 order with distinct marker shapes or legend swatches.

props.name: rows
props.description: Stable ids, category names and values: finite numbers or explicitly named unknown/not-applicable values. ready requires actual records; donut requires exactly one row, with every part a known non-negative number.
props.descriptionEn: Stable ids, category names and values: finite numbers or explicitly named unknown/not-applicable values. ready requires actual records; donut requires exactly one row, with every part a known non-negative number.

props.name: contextLabel
props.description: Required when there are context series: the one legend entry that stands for them (a faint ink key plus this name), e.g. "Other rooms". Their individual names appear only in the equivalent table. Throws when missing.
props.descriptionEn: Required when there are context series: the one legend entry that stands for them (a faint ink key plus this name), e.g. "Other rooms". Their individual names appear only in the equivalent table. Throws when missing.

props.name: references
props.type: ({ kind: "band"; from: number; to: number; label: string } | { kind: "line"; value: number; label: string })[]
props.description: References on the value axis: a target band or a reference line (horizontal for vertical charts, vertical for bar-horizontal). Drawn in ink behind the data; the value axis range includes them automatically. label is required and appears in the legend and in a note under the data table; a band needs from < to and finite values; a donut throws. With a band, the hover readout adds a line per value for its position against the target (above or below by how much, or within); with several bands only the first is used.
props.descriptionEn: References on the value axis: a target band or a reference line (horizontal for vertical charts, vertical for bar-horizontal). Drawn in ink behind the data; the value axis range includes them automatically. label is required and appears in the legend and in a note under the data table; a band needs from < to and finite values; a donut throws. With a band, the hover readout adds a line per value for its position against the target (above or below by how much, or within); with several bands only the first is used.

props.name: events
props.type: readonly { rowId: string; label: string; tone?: Tone }[]
props.description: Events on a row of the category axis: a dot on the baseline (category color when tone is given, ink otherwise). The label appears in that row's hover readout and as an "Event" column of the data table. A missing rowId, or a donut, throws.
props.descriptionEn: Events on a row of the category axis: a dot on the baseline (category color when tone is given, ink otherwise). The label appears in that row's hover readout and as an "Event" column of the data table. A missing rowId, or a donut, throws.

props.name: valueDomain
props.description: Value axis range, for line only: position encoding may leave zero, e.g. a ratio from 80% to 100%. Any other type throws a RangeError (bars and areas encode by length or area and must start at zero). min < max; a known value or reference outside the range throws, since cutting data off misstates it. Ticks are 1, 2, 2.5 or 5 times a power of ten, at most six.
props.descriptionEn: Value axis range, for line only: position encoding may leave zero, e.g. a ratio from 80% to 100%. Any other type throws a RangeError (bars and areas encode by length or area and must start at zero). min < max; a known value or reference outside the range throws, since cutting data off misstates it. Ticks are 1, 2, 2.5 or 5 times a power of ten, at most six.

props.name: total
props.description: Donut only: the whole's total. Defaults to the sum of its parts; a larger value folds the remainder into a neutral "rest" slice (groove-surface, not a sixth hue).
props.descriptionEn: Donut only: the whole's total. Defaults to the sum of its parts; a larger value folds the remainder into a neutral "rest" slice (groove-surface, not a sixth hue).

props.name: valueLabels
props.description: Put the formatted value just outside the data end of each bar (above a vertical bar, after the end of a horizontal one, on the other side for negative values); value-axis ticks and grid are then no longer drawn and the baseline stays. Only for bar and bar-horizontal, a single series and at most 12 rows (each category band must hold a label); any other type, several series or more rows throws. Text is ink, dense step, tabular figures; formatValue is read for strings or numbers only and falls back to the default number format when it returns a node.
props.descriptionEn: Put the formatted value just outside the data end of each bar (above a vertical bar, after the end of a horizontal one, on the other side for negative values); value-axis ticks and grid are then no longer drawn and the baseline stays. Only for bar and bar-horizontal, a single series and at most 12 rows (each category band must hold a label); any other type, several series or more rows throws. Text is ink, dense step, tabular figures; formatValue is read for strings or numbers only and falls back to the default number format when it returns a node.

props.name: formatValue
props.description: Format known values without changing data. Defaults to Intl number formatting for UILocale. Totals, donut legend values and the remainder call it with the first series (stacked and donut series share one unit); share readouts, value labels and the donut legend read strings or numbers only.
props.descriptionEn: Format known values without changing data. Defaults to Intl number formatting for UILocale. Totals, donut legend values and the remainder call it with the first series (stacked and donut series share one unit); share readouts, value labels and the donut legend read strings or numbers only.

props.name: renderPlot
props.description: Replace the same-source plot. Gaps project to null; the default LineChart neither connects gaps nor animates. Names, legend and visible Table remain. Custom plots own their interaction and ARIA; the projection carries references, events and valueDomain, and series carry context and tone, which a custom plot should honor (no markers on context series, references behind the data).
props.descriptionEn: Replace the same-source plot. Gaps project to null; the default LineChart neither connects gaps nor animates. Names, legend and visible Table remain. Custom plots own their interaction and ARIA; the projection carries references, events and valueDomain, and series carry context and tone, which a custom plot should honor (no markers on context series, references behind the data).

props.name: style / className / render / ref
props.description: Root style may override --qy-chart-plot-height (default 10 modules). Line width, markers and bar width are fixed by the chart's rules rather than configured individually.
props.descriptionEn: Root style may override --qy-chart-plot-height (default 10 modules). Line width, markers and bar width are fixed by the chart's rules rather than configured individually.

methods: Complementary roles and safeguards （相成相制）
Space supports the task （布白有用）
whenToUse: Real values in shared units need graphical comparison with reachable numeric equivalents.
Readers need to know whether a value is in range: use references for a target band or line rather than making them read it off the grid.
One quantity is read against its peers: make the other series context series so only the one in question takes a color.
A change has a known cause: mark it with events on the category axis; the name enters the readout and the data table.
A line reads change inside a narrow interval (a ratio from 80% to 100%): use valueDomain; bars and areas cannot.
The series are themselves status categories (succeeded, retrying, failed): use tone, declared by the application, never guessed from the value.
A value is held between two changes (a setpoint, a threshold, stock): use interpolation: "step" instead of a straight line that invents values in between.
How a composition changes matters more than how much: bar-share (across categories) or area-share (over time), with original value and share together in the readout and table.
Few bars whose exact values must be read: use valueLabels to put the numbers on the bars and drop the ticks and grid.
Switching the time range or metric: no prop for it — keep the range in application state, pick it with SegmentedControl, and let Chart only receive different rows.
avoid: Mixed units, guessed results, connecting unavailable values as a reliable trend, or relying on color alone.
A donut with more than five parts, or where share must be compared precisely rather than glanced at.
Truncating the value axis of bars or areas (valueDomain throws for them).
Using a reference, context line or event dot as the only carrier of data: they are ink and background, and the numbers are in the data table.
Mixing tone with ordered-color series, or two series of the same category.

Smooth curves between points (not offered: a curve draws values the data does not contain); reading absolute amounts off a share chart; labelling stacked segments or side-by-side bars (too narrow, labels crowd together; valueLabels does not accept them).
composition: Public Recharts primitives with the current Table; one rows/series projection. With nothing to plot, the caller renders Empty in place of the chart.

library: Same-source projection, visible equivalent table, series shapes and basic naming.
application: Data, units, truth, state content and custom plotting.

responsive: A centralized 12em plot height can be overridden. The table scrolls and wraps without cutting actual values.
customization: Existing chart1..5 semantic colors, local plot roles and public renderPlot; no separate chart palette. Series colors follow the fixed order, which is the color-vision-safe mechanism and is not freely configurable; status colors are only danger / warning / success / info.

en.title: ColorPicker
en.description: Choose a colour that belongs to the user's data, such as a label colour or a theme setting, and get a #rrggbb string.
en.decisions: It only produces user data and never changes the library theme: a swatch shows exactly that data, and every other colour still comes from semantic tokens. The value is #rrggbb only, with no transparency; storing it is the application's job.
notes: Selection is shown by a check, not by colour; the check is the black or white with more contrast against that swatch.
A swatch has a rim with the same role as an input border, so white or ground-coloured swatches keep a clear edge in light and dark themes.
The saturation and brightness area exposes two named hidden range inputs; aria-valuetext reads the channel and the current hex.
No transparency: the value is #rrggbb only.

components.name: combobox
components.title: 候选输入 Combobox
components.description: 筛选候选并确认一个或一组值，查询文字与选择事实分别持有。
notes: 从当前查询到候选的过滤与空内容必须对应实际数据。
Popup 的 caller style 最后合并；覆写层级可能改变默认顺序。
候选浮层表面与高亮采用既有主题预设，焦点信号在盒内。
异步候选由应用持有请求、取消与失败；传 filter={null} 关闭内置过滤，用 ComboboxStatus 说明加载与结果数，用 ComboboxEmpty 说明没有结果（加载期间不要显示它）。ComboboxEmpty 省略 children 时用内置的「没有可选项」，与 Select 同一说法与画法。

api.name: ComboboxSelect
api.description: 平铺单选的便捷组合：编辑边界、输入、清除、展开与候选面；确认值与查询仍独立，可受控或非受控。分组、多选或不同解剖继续用公开部件。
api.descriptionEn: A convenient composition for flat single selection: edit boundary, input, clear, trigger, and popup. Confirmation and query remain independent and can be controlled or uncontrolled. Use the public parts for groups, multiple selection, or a different anatomy.

props.name: items / itemToStringLabel / renderItem
props.type: readonly Value[] / (item: Value) => string / (item: Value) => ReactNode
props.description: items 和 itemToStringLabel 必填，名称同时用于输入与过滤；renderItem 可丰富候选呈现。对象提交身份用既有 itemToStringValue，比较用 isItemEqualToValue。
props.descriptionEn: items and itemToStringLabel are required; labels serve both input and filtering. renderItem customizes candidate content. For objects, use the existing itemToStringValue for form identity and isItemEqualToValue for equality.

props.name: emptyContent / loading / clearable
props.description: emptyContent 必填；loading 只显示调用方的加载事实，此时不声称无匹配。请求、取消、迟到回包与有效候选由应用持有。clearable 控制是否提供明确清除选择的动作。
props.descriptionEn: emptyContent is required. loading only presents caller-supplied loading and suppresses no-match text. The application owns requests, cancellation, late responses, and valid candidates. clearable controls the explicit clear-selection action.

props.name: inputProps / controlProps / popupProps
props.description: 分别透传输入命名、ARIA、事件、render、ref，编辑边界与浮层定制。确认值、查询、表单、禁用及只读沿用 Combobox Root 属性。
props.descriptionEn: Forward input naming, ARIA, events, render, and ref, plus control and popup customization. Confirmation, query, form, disabled, and read-only retain Combobox Root props.

api.name: Combobox
api.description: 公开 Base UI 候选上下文，默认单值；不强加业务选项。
api.descriptionEn: A public Base UI candidate context, single-value by default, with caller-provided options.

props.name: multiple
props.description: 确认一组值：value 为数组，FormData 每个值一条；已选值在编辑边界内成为可单独移除的项。
props.descriptionEn: Confirm a set: value is an array with one FormData entry per value; each selected value becomes an individually removable chip inside the edit boundary.

props.name: value / defaultValue / onValueChange
props.type: Value | null / Value | null / (value, details) => void
props.description: 受控或非受控确认值。details.cancel() 拒绝变更；回调不表示提交或持久化成功。
props.descriptionEn: Controlled or uncontrolled confirmation. details.cancel() rejects changes. A callback does not mean submission or persistence.

props.name: inputValue / defaultInputValue / onInputValueChange
props.description: 独立过滤文字；不序列化成候选值，也不因清空查询清除确认候选。
props.descriptionEn: Independent query text. It is not serialized as selection and does not clear confirmation when emptied.

props.name: items / itemToStringLabel / itemToStringValue / isItemEqualToValue
props.description: 调用方提供候选、可读名称、表单值与身份比较；对象值须定义有意义的名称与提交表示。
props.descriptionEn: The caller provides candidates, readable labels, form strings, and identity equality. Define meaningful labels and submission values for objects.

props.name: name / form / required / disabled / readOnly
props.description: Field 命名与错误连接由原语承担；FormData 只提交确认候选。只读保留提交，禁用排除。
props.descriptionEn: The primitive connects Field naming and errors. FormData submits confirmed selection only. Read-only submits; disabled is excluded.

props.name: open / defaultOpen / onOpenChange
props.description: 展开可控；输入、动作、候选项共用一套几何，跟随密度轴。
props.descriptionEn: Opening is controllable. Input, actions, and items share one geometry following the density axis.

api.name: ComboboxInput / ComboboxTrigger / ComboboxClear
api.description: 公开原语复用 Input 原生出口与 Button；事件、ARIA、render 状态与 ref 透传，Field 注册一次。
api.descriptionEn: Public primitives compose the native Input outlet and Button. Events, ARIA, render state, and refs forward with one Field registration.

api.name: ComboboxControl
api.description: 输入、清除与展开共用的一条编辑边界，候选面以它为锚点；多选时可换行，装下已选项。
api.descriptionEn: One edit boundary shared by input, clear, and trigger, anchoring the popup; with multiple it wraps to hold the chips.

api.name: ComboboxChips / ComboboxChip / ComboboxValue
api.description: 多选的已选项。Chips 放在 Control 内，包住各项与 Input；Value 以函数子级给出已选数组；Chip 自带移除动作，只读时只显示值。几何与 TagInput 的标签相同。
api.descriptionEn: Selected values for multiple. Chips sits inside Control around the chips and Input; Value provides the selected array to a function child; Chip carries its own remove action and shows only the value when read-only. Geometry matches TagInput tags.

props.name: label (ComboboxChip)
props.description: 移除动作的对象名；children 是纯文字时取 children。
props.descriptionEn: The object name for the remove action; defaults to children when they are plain text.

api.name: ComboboxPopup
api.description: 候选专属 Portal/Positioner/Popup；positionerProps/container 可调整公开定位，层级消费共享 floating-layer。
api.descriptionEn: Candidate-specific Portal/Positioner/Popup. positionerProps and container customize positioning; layer order comes from shared floating-layer.

api.name: ComboboxList / ComboboxItem / ComboboxEmpty
api.description: 真实候选集合、可选项与调用方空内容；Item.value 是确认候选。
api.descriptionEn: Real candidate list, selectable items, and caller-provided empty content. Item.value is a confirmation candidate.

api.name: ComboboxGroup / ComboboxGroupLabel / ComboboxSeparator / ComboboxCollection
api.description: 分组候选：items 用 Base UI 的分组形态（{ value: 组名, items }），列表以函数子级逐组渲染，组内用 ComboboxCollection。组名画法与 SelectGroupLabel、分隔线与 MenuSeparator 同一来源；组名不可选、不入键盘序列。多选下同样成立。
api.descriptionEn: Grouped candidates: items use Base UI's group shape ({ value: label, items }); the list renders group by group with ComboboxCollection inside. The label matches SelectGroupLabel and the separator matches MenuSeparator. Labels are not selectable or part of the keyboard sequence. Works with multiple.

api.name: ComboboxStatus
api.description: 列表自身状态的读屏播报：loading 读「正在加载」，count 读「找到 N 项」，也可直接给 children。放进 ComboboxPopup 并保持挂载，变的是内容。默认只给读屏；visible 同时显示在 Empty 的位置。count 为 0 不出声：「没有结果」归 ComboboxEmpty，不重复播报。
api.descriptionEn: Screen-reader announcements about the list itself: loading says "Loading", count says "N results", or pass children. Put it in ComboboxPopup and keep it mounted; only its content changes. Screen-reader only by default; visible also shows it where Empty sits. A count of 0 stays silent: "no results" belongs to ComboboxEmpty.

props.name: loading / count / visible
props.description: 加载中、结果数、是否同时显示；children 优先于内置文案。
props.descriptionEn: Loading, result count, and whether to also show it; children win over built-in text.

api.descriptionEn: The installed Base UI Combobox namespace.

components.decisions: value 是确认候选，inputValue 是过滤草稿。清空过滤文字继续保留候选，明确清除选择才请求空值；自由文本值用 Autocomplete。候选很多且要选几个时用 multiple；候选少而需要一眼看全用 CheckboxGroup，值不来自候选用 TagInput。

en.title: Combobox
en.description: Filter candidates and confirm one value or a set, with query text separate from selection.
en.decisions: value is the confirmed candidate; inputValue is the filter draft. Emptying the query preserves selection. Explicit Clear requests an empty selection. Use Autocomplete for free text. Use multiple to pick several from many candidates; use CheckboxGroup when few options should all stay visible, and TagInput when values do not come from candidates.
notes: Filtering and empty content must reflect the real candidate data.
Popup caller style merges last; layer overrides can change the default order.
Popup surfaces and highlights use existing theme presets with internal focus signals.

For asynchronous candidates the application owns requests, cancellation, and failure: pass filter={null}, use ComboboxStatus for loading and counts, and ComboboxEmpty for no results (not while loading). An empty ComboboxEmpty uses the built-in "No options", worded and drawn like Select.

api.name: ComboboxSelect
api.description: A convenient composition for flat single selection: edit boundary, input, clear, trigger, and popup. Confirmation and query remain independent and can be controlled or uncontrolled. Use the public parts for groups, multiple selection, or a different anatomy.

props.name: emptyContent / loading / clearable
props.description: emptyContent is required. loading only presents caller-supplied loading and suppresses no-match text. The application owns requests, cancellation, late responses, and valid candidates. clearable controls the explicit clear-selection action.

components.name: command

components.description: 输入框加一张常开的命令列表，用来跳到某处或执行某事。
notes: 组件不注册 ⌘K。应用自己监听 metaKey / ctrlKey + k 并控制 CommandDialog 的 open。
条目 value 是匹配用的文字；显示内容与 value 不同时，用 keywords 补上能被搜到的词。
命令的后果（删除、发布等）不在命令面板里说明：选中后应打开 AlertDialog 或 ConfirmAction。
按「候选值」选择文字用 Autocomplete 或 Combobox；命令面板选的是动作。

en.title: Command
en.description: A search box over an always-open list of commands, for jumping somewhere or doing something.
en.decisions: Items are commands (actions), not values filled into the input: selecting only fires onSelect and the query text stays. The global shortcut (⌘K) is registered by the application; the library listens to no keys. Disabled items show as unavailable but take no part in highlighting or arrow-key movement.
notes: The component does not register ⌘K. The application listens for metaKey / ctrlKey + k and controls the CommandDialog's open.
An item's value is the text it matches on. When the displayed content differs from the value, add keywords for terms that should find it.
Consequences of a command (delete, publish, …) are not explained in the palette: selecting one should open an AlertDialog or ConfirmAction.
Use Autocomplete or Combobox to choose a text value; a command palette chooses an action.

components.decisions: 编辑区是 contenteditable，因为令牌必须是行内原子对象（整体删除、光标进不去、读屏读名字），原生文本框做不到。值是片段数组而不是字符串：令牌带稳定 id，应用不必从文字里反解。候选浮层按 combobox 模式接线，但编辑区的角色是 textbox（多行的 combobox 不存在）。消息列表与气泡不在库内。

en.title: Composer
en.description: Multi-line input with @ mentions, / commands and atomic tokens; its value is an array of text and token segments.
en.decisions: The editor is contenteditable because tokens must be inline atoms (deleted whole, unreachable by the caret, read by name), which a native text box cannot do. The value is an array of segments, not a string, so a token keeps a stable id and apps need not parse text back. The candidate popup follows the combobox pattern, but the editor's role is textbox since no multi-line combobox exists. Message lists and bubbles are not in the library.
notes: Paste and drop accept plain text only; copy and cut emit plain text with a token written as trigger + label.
composerValueToText writes a token as trigger + label by default; composerValueFromText accepts known tokens and restores them by literal match.
There is no name or form submission and no Field integration; read the value in onSubmit.
jsdom cannot verify a real IME, per-browser contenteditable caret and beforeinput behavior, popup collision flipping or Range geometry; verify these in real browsers.

components.name: confirm
components.title: 异步确认 Confirm
components.description: 等待一次明确决定，再由调用方继续执行。
notes: 同一 Provider 同刻只显示一个决定；其余按调用顺序排队，包含同一事件中的重复调用与退场期间。排队中的调用可被 signal 中止，所属 hook 卸载或 Provider 卸载时返回 false。
调用 useConfirm 的组件卸载会取消它自己的未决决定；保留的旧函数在卸载后也只返回 false。
授权与执行分开：组件不接收 onConfirm 请求函数，不显示提交中，不推断成功、失败或结果未知。
需要文字核对、对象与版本变化后重新审阅时使用 ConfirmAction；一般组合控制使用 AlertDialog。

props.name: title / description
props.description: 必需且非空；标题标识决定，说明持续显示必要后果并建立可访问关联。调用时捕获选项，之后修改原 options 不替换已读内容。

props.name: confirmLabel / cancelLabel
props.description: confirmLabel 必填，写出这个决定具体做什么（「移出」「离开」），没有通用的「确认」默认；缺省或空白抛 TypeError。取消按钮和 Escape 都返回 false；点遮罩不关闭。

props.name: popupProps

props.descriptionEn: Reuse public popup render, refs, ARIA, structural layers, and focus targets. Focus starts on the safe panel and returns to the element active at the call. Supply finalFocus with a surviving parent when the entry may be removed.

props.name: signal
props.description: 已中止的调用直接 false；决定中中止会关闭并返回 false。只中止此次决定，不取消已开始的业务请求。
props.descriptionEn: An already-aborted call immediately resolves false. Aborting an active decision closes it and resolves false. This cancels the decision only, not a business request already started.

props.name: Promise<boolean>
props.description: 确认立即返回 true 并关窗；取消、中止、hook 调用方或 Provider 卸载均返回 false。业务执行不等待退场动画；应用用 Button loading、try/finally 和就地错误承接执行与恢复。

components.decisions: await confirm(options) 只返回是否同意；true 不表示提交成功。已有决定在进行时，后续调用排队，前一个结束并退场后再依次打开，各自的 Promise 各自结算；false 只表示决定者拒绝。涉及对象、版本或变更失效时使用 ConfirmAction。

en.title: Confirm
en.description: Await one explicit decision, then let the caller continue.
en.decisions: await confirm(options) returns approval only; true does not mean a submission succeeded. While a decision is active or closing, later calls wait in order and open after the previous one has closed; each Promise settles on its own, and false only means the decision-maker declined. Use ConfirmAction when changes to an object, version, or change must invalidate approval.
notes: One decision shows per provider; the rest wait in call order, including repeated calls in one event and during closing. A waiting call can be aborted by its signal and resolves false when its hook owner or the provider unmounts.
Unmounting the useConfirm owner cancels its own pending decision. Retained functions also resolve false after the owner unmounts.
Approval and execution are separate: this component accepts no request callback, displays no submitting state, and infers no success, failure, or unknown outcome.
Use ConfirmAction for exact text checks and review after object or version changes; use AlertDialog for direct composition.

en.title: ConfirmAction
en.description: Confirm a specific object, version, and change; review again when content changes.
en.decisions: Confirmation targets the reviewed opening snapshot. Changed identity, version, change, or consequence invalidates prior approval. Reviewing again clears confirmation text. onConfirm is a request; resolving a Promise neither infers success nor closes the dialog.
notes: Restoring old content does not revive old approval; review again.
The application owns action attempts and outcomes. There is no custom timeout, fake success, or automatic retry.
Layering, sizes, focus, and consequence association use current public components and centralized presets.
Use ConfirmProvider + useConfirm for a general awaited boolean decision; retain this component for object, version, and change protection.

While a request is in flight the dialog cannot be closed (not by Esc, outside press or Back); once the result arrives, the application decides when to close it. This component does not keep failed objects or their reasons, and they do not return once the dialog closes: the application should write them to the page before closing (an Alert listing which objects failed and why, with retry or dismiss) and keep them until the user deals with them. See "Failures stay on the page".

api.name: useCopyToClipboard
api.description: CopyButton 背后的 hook；需要自己的按钮外形或触发时机时直接用它。从包根或 @qingye_lab/ui/hooks/use-copy-to-clipboard 导入。返回 { copyToClipboard, isCopying, isCopied }：copyToClipboard(value) 写入 value，navigator.clipboard 不存在（如 http 页面）或被拒绝时回退到临时 textarea + execCommand("copy") 并把焦点还给原元素，回退也失败才走 onError；重复调用只认最后一次，卸载后不再更新状态。isCopying 在写入进行中；isCopied 在写入成功后的 timeout 内为 true；失败时两者都为 false。
api.descriptionEn: The hook behind CopyButton, for when you need your own button form or trigger. Import from the package root or @qingye_lab/ui/hooks/use-copy-to-clipboard. Returns { copyToClipboard, isCopying, isCopied }: copyToClipboard(value) writes value; when navigator.clipboard is absent (for example on an http page) or rejects, it falls back to a temporary textarea + execCommand("copy") and returns focus to the previous element, and onError runs only if the fallback also fails. Only the latest call counts; no state updates after unmount. isCopying is true while the write is in flight; isCopied is true for timeout after a successful write; both are false after a failure.

props.descriptionEn: Milliseconds isCopied stays true; clears feedback only and never establishes success.

en.title: Copy button
en.description: Copy supplied text and reflect the clipboard write result.
en.decisions: CopyButton uses useCopyToClipboard; success comes from the write Promise resolving. Feedback duration, the quiet default, and icons are choices or presets.
notes: Clipboard access needs environment support and permission. Without the Clipboard API (for example on http) the selection copy command is used; only when both fail does the manual-copy message show, never silently.
The button keeps its width when it switches to Copied: both labels share one cell and the wider sets the size.
onCopySuccess confirms only writing the supplied text to the current clipboard, not saving or business completion.

api.name: useCopyToClipboard
api.description: The hook behind CopyButton, for when you need your own button form or trigger. Import from the package root or @qingye_lab/ui/hooks/use-copy-to-clipboard. Returns { copyToClipboard, isCopying, isCopied }: copyToClipboard(value) writes value; when navigator.clipboard is absent (for example on an http page) or rejects, it falls back to a temporary textarea + execCommand("copy") and returns focus to the previous element, and onError runs only if the fallback also fails. Only the latest call counts; no state updates after unmount. isCopying is true while the write is in flight; isCopied is true for timeout after a successful write; both are false after a failure.

components.description: 钉在宿主一角的未读数或在线点，不是宿主内容本身。

api.description: 包裹宿主内容，角标钉在宿主的右上角。

props.name: count / max
props.description: 计数档；超过 max（默认 99）显示「max+」，真实数字仍在 label 里；count 为 0 时角标与 label 一起消失。
props.descriptionEn: The count variant; past max (default 99) it reads "max+" while the real number stays in label; a count of 0 hides the mark and its label together.

props.descriptionEn: A digit-free dot variant, mutually exclusive with count.

props.name: label
props.description: 角标本身 aria-hidden；这段视觉隐藏文字是数字或状态唯一确定能被读屏听到的途径，开发环境缺失时会抛错。
props.descriptionEn: The mark itself is aria-hidden; this visually hidden text is the only guaranteed path for the count or status to reach assistive technology. Missing it throws in development.

props.name: tone
props.description: 默认焦墨；success、danger 是已有语义类别，没有脱离类别的彩色。
props.descriptionEn: Defaults to ink; success and danger are existing semantic categories, never hue without meaning.

props.name: className / wrapperClassName
props.description: className 作用于角标本身（例如覆盖纸色圈，使其匹配实际承载面）；wrapperClassName 作用于外层定位容器。

components.name: data-table
components.title: 数据集合 DataTable
components.description: 调用方真实集合的比较、排序、范围选择与可选虚拟化。
notes: 标准组合从 components/data-table 导入 DataTablePattern；分页内置复用 PaginationPattern。跨页选择的对象内容、权限与批量执行范围仍由应用核实。
TanStack 为已声明的可选 peer；应用明确启用排序/筛选/分页模型。
只用排序与选择、不分页时，给 useReactTable 传 `autoResetAll: false`：它的自动重置在渲染之外排队更新状态，页面经 Suspense 懒加载时，被丢弃的那次渲染会让 React 报「未挂载组件更新状态」。
固定布局中未写 size 的文字列是弹性列，平分定宽列与标记列之外的剩余空间；标记列仍按已有 marker 与单元格内缘角色取宽。列宽过小不会裁掉交互控件，请给操作列留下真实容量。
虚拟化保留 table/thead/tbody/tr/th/td。aria-rowcount 与 aria-rowindex 描述当前表格页（含表头），不把服务端全局总数冒充已加载行；全选仍覆盖当前模型的完整范围。
虚拟行按稳定 ID 测量，支持实际可变行高；estimateRowHeight 应接近真实行高，未测量的远端行仍是估计。建议显式列宽，避免自动布局因窗口内容变化而重排；纯客户端页面需要查看或打印所有行时关闭虚拟化。
焦点所在的离屏行额外保留一行，输入草稿不因滚动丢失；该行移出当前模型时，焦点仍属于它才回到滚动容器。

api.name: DataTablePattern
api.description: 配置式排序、当页全选、活动行与分页组合，不发请求。
api.descriptionEn: Configured sorting, page selection, active rows and pagination without issuing requests.

props.name: data / columns / getRowId / emptyContent
props.description: 列显式配置 id、header、accessor、cell、sortable、rowHeader、numeric；可选 size、minSize、maxSize（px）与 ellipsis。写了 size 的列定宽，没写的列平分剩余空间。稳定 getRowId 必填。
props.descriptionEn: Columns configure id, header, accessor, cell, sortable, rowHeader and numeric, with optional size/minSize/maxSize in pixels and ellipsis. Columns with size are fixed; columns without it share the remaining width. Stable getRowId is required.

props.name: state / defaultState / onStateChange
props.description: sorting、pagination、rowSelection、activeRowId 共用快照；排序与回到第 1 页只通知一次。外部页码从 1 开始。
props.descriptionEn: A shared snapshot contains sorting, pagination, rowSelection and activeRowId; sorting and reset to page 1 produce one notification. Public page numbers start at 1.

props.name: mode / pagination
props.description: client 对完整数据排序切片并从 data.length 得到总数；server 只展示传入页，分页必须给 totalCount；未知 null 时还必须给 hasNextPage。
props.descriptionEn: Client mode sorts/slices complete data and derives totals from data.length; server mode presents supplied rows and requires totalCount, plus explicit hasNextPage when null.

props.name: selection
props.description: 启用选择列；全选只改当页可选行并保留范围外 ID。服务端完整选中范围读取 state.rowSelection，不读当前页的 getSelectedRowModel。
props.descriptionEn: Enables selection; select-all changes eligible rows on the current page while preserving outside IDs. Read state.rowSelection for the complete server selection, not the loaded-page getSelectedRowModel.

props.name: activeRow
props.type: ({ trigger?: 'cell', columnId: string } | { trigger: 'row' }) & { onActivate?: (row: T) => void }
props.description: 默认在指定列放激活按钮，cell 保持非交互内容；trigger=row 时点击行正文或聚焦行后按 Enter/Space。内部控件、链接、label 与编辑区不触发行激活；活动行与复选状态独立。
props.descriptionEn: By default the named column gets an activation button and its cell must be noninteractive. With trigger=row, click row content or focus the row and press Enter/Space. Nested controls, links, labels and editors do not activate the row; activation and selection remain independent.

props.name: selectionAppearance
props.description: checkbox 只取消选中行的底色，真实复选框仍保留；活动行的强调独立保留。
props.descriptionEn: Checkbox mode removes only selected-row fill, retaining actual checkboxes and independent active-row emphasis.

props.name: virtualization
props.type: { height: number, estimateRowHeight: number, overscan?: number }
props.description: 显式启用当前行模型的虚拟化；height 含 caption 与表头，实际行高自动测量。尺寸须有限且为正，overscan 为非负整数（默认 1）。
props.descriptionEn: Explicitly virtualizes the current row model. Height includes the caption and header; actual row heights are measured. Dimensions must be finite and positive; overscan is a nonnegative integer, defaulting to 1.

props.name: stickyHeader / stickyHeaderOffset
props.description: 表头吸在最近的滚动区顶部：表格横向放得下时是页面或 Workspace 内容区；横向溢出的宽表、虚拟化视口，或 tableProps.containerProps 设了 height / max-height 时，是表格自己的容器。stickyHeaderOffset 让开滚动区顶上的固定页眉，数字按 px。
props.descriptionEn: Sticks the header to the top of the nearest scroll area: the page or Workspace content when the table fits horizontally; the table's own container for a horizontally overflowing table, the virtualization viewport, or a height / max-height set through tableProps.containerProps. stickyHeaderOffset clears a fixed bar above that area; numbers are px.

props.name: columns[].pinned / columns[].empty
props.description: pinned 固定从第一列起连续的前导列（选择列自动一并固定，不连续时抛错），横向滚动后末端出现一条线。empty 是无 cell 的列在 null、undefined、空串时显示的内容，默认「—」加读屏的「无值」；0 照常显示。未知与不适用由调用方用 empty 区分。
props.descriptionEn: pinned fixes a contiguous run of leading columns (the selection column is pinned with them; non-contiguous pins throw) and draws an edge line once scrolled sideways. empty replaces the default dash plus screen-reader 'No value' for null, undefined or empty strings in columns without cell; zero still renders. Callers distinguish unknown from not applicable through empty.

props.name: caption / busy / error / tableProps / native div props
props.type: ReactNode / boolean / ReactNode / DataTableProps / HTML props
props.description: busy 时旧数据行不动，表格顶缘出现不定进度记号，分页暂时挡住翻页但焦点留在原按钮。error 由应用给出内容和重试动作，摆在表格上方并声明 role=alert，旧数据行同样保留。属性分别归属表格或组合外层，不推断请求成功或失败。
props.descriptionEn: While busy the old rows stay put, an indeterminate mark appears along the top edge and the pager blocks paging while keeping focus on the pressed button. error is application content with its own retry action, placed above the table as role=alert; old rows stay as well. Props target the table or composition root and never infer request outcomes.

api.name: DataTable
api.description: 原生二维集合。
api.descriptionEn: A native two-dimensional collection.

props.name: table / emptyContent / caption / busy / error / activeRowId / containerProps
props.description: getRowId 必填、至少一列；零值/caption 保留，busy 不删除有效 rows，也不变暗。数据行悬停读悬停面，选中与活动行保持更深的选中面。error 摆在表格上方（role=alert），应用自带重试动作。
props.descriptionEn: GetRowId and at least one visible column are required; zero and caption are retained, and busy keeps valid rows without dimming them. Data rows take the hover surface on pointer hover; selected and active rows keep the deeper selected surface. error is placed above the table as role=alert and carries its own retry action.

props.name: table.options.columns[].size / table.options.columns[].minSize / table.options.columns[].maxSize / table.options.state.columnSizing
props.description: 实际像素列宽，按 minSize/maxSize 钳制。显式配置任一尺寸或非空 columnSizing 时启用固定布局与 colgroup；未配置尺寸时保持原生自动布局。写了 size（或 defaultColumn.size，或 columnSizing 里有它）的列定宽，标记列取内容宽，其余列是弹性列：表宽 100%，弹性列平分剩余空间，minSize 是它的下限，未写 minSize 时下限为 150px（TanStack 默认 size）。表格最小宽度 = 定宽列之和 + 标记列之和 + 弹性列数 × 各弹性列下限的最大值，窄于此值时横向滚动。弹性列的 maxSize 不约束宽度，需要上限就写 size。没有弹性列时表宽等于各列之和，组合表头取可见叶列之和。不内置拖拽调宽。
props.descriptionEn: Actual pixel widths clamped by minSize/maxSize. Any explicit dimension or nonempty columnSizing opts into fixed layout with colgroup; otherwise native auto layout remains. A column with size (or defaultColumn.size, or an entry in columnSizing) is fixed, a marker column takes its content width, and every other column is flexible: the table is 100% wide, flexible columns split the remaining space, minSize is a flexible column's floor, and without minSize the floor is 150px (TanStack's default size). The table's minimum width is the fixed columns plus the marker columns plus the flexible column count times the largest flexible floor; below it the table scrolls horizontally. maxSize does not constrain a flexible column; write size when a cap is needed. Without flexible columns the table is as wide as its columns together, and grouped headers sum visible leaf widths. Drag resizing is not built in.

props.name: columnDef.meta.ellipsis
props.description: 对非交互的表头与单元格文字启用单行省略。完整文字始终在 DOM 与可访问名称里；真的被截断时这一格成为键盘停靠点，聚焦或悬停以 Tooltip 显示全文（不用原生 title：键盘与触屏读不到）。放得下的格不占 Tab 序列。含控件的内容不裁切。不省略时单元格默认折行显示全文；列宽决定容量，关键后果仍应直接可见。
props.descriptionEn: Ellipsizes noninteractive header/cell text on one line. The full text always stays in the DOM and accessible name; when actually truncated the cell becomes a keyboard stop and shows the full text in a Tooltip on focus or hover (not a native title, which keyboards and touch cannot read). Cells that fit stay out of the Tab sequence. Interactive content is not clipped. Without ellipsis cells wrap and show the full text; column widths determine capacity, so keep critical consequences visible.

props.name: columnDef.meta.numeric
props.description: 数值列由列定义声明，不由内容猜：表头与该列每个单元格同一对齐——行内末端（RTL 下在左）并用等宽数字。Pattern 的列配置同名。
props.descriptionEn: A numeric column is declared by the column definition, never guessed from content: header and every cell share one alignment, at the inline end (left in RTL), with tabular figures. The Pattern column config uses the same name.

props.name: selectionAppearance / onRowActivate / virtualization
props.description: 选择外观与虚拟化同 Pattern；行激活回调收到 TanStack Row，调用方持有 activeRowId。整张表只有一行在 Tab 序列里（最近聚焦的行，否则活动行，否则第一行），方向键在行间移动。点击内部交互元素不激活，data-row-activate-ignore 可排除自定义区域；不改变选择。需要一个可见的 meta.rowHeader 列给行命名，否则抛错。
props.descriptionEn: Selection appearance and virtualization match Pattern. Row activation receives a TanStack Row; the caller owns activeRowId. Only one row is in the Tab sequence (the last focused row, else the active row, else the first) and arrow keys move between rows. Nested interactive elements and custom data-row-activate-ignore regions are excluded, and activation never changes selection. A visible meta.rowHeader column is required to name the rows; without one it throws.

props.name: columnDef.meta.rowHeader
props.description: 实际行标题用 th scope=row；比较列不自动隐藏。有可见行标题列时，每一行的 aria-labelledby 指向该行所有行标题单元格，行的可访问名称即这些单元格的文字（多个行标题列按列序连接）。DataTableSelectionCell 用它给每个选择框命名为「选择“该行名称”」，没有行标题列时才用泛称。设置了 onRowActivate 却没有可见的行标题列时抛错。
props.descriptionEn: Actual row headers use th scope=row; comparison columns are never automatically hidden. With a visible row-header column, each row's aria-labelledby points at all of its row-header cells, so the row's accessible name is their text (several row-header columns join in column order). DataTableSelectionCell names each checkbox after this row, falling back to a generic name only without a row-header column. onRowActivate without a visible row-header column throws.

props.name: render / ref / native props
props.description: 属性和 ref 归属实际元素；调用方事件与样式保留。

ownProps.name: busy
ownProps.doc:

ownProps.doc:
取数失败等需要读者处理的情况，由应用给出内容（说明与重试动作）；组件只把它摆在表格上方并声明 role="alert"。

ownProps.doc: Click noninteractive row content, or focus the row and press Enter / Space. Never toggles selection. 需要至少一个可见的 meta.rowHeader 列来给每一行命名，否则抛错。

ownProps.name: error

ownProps.name: loading
ownProps.doc:
这个动作正在执行。事实由调用方持有；按钮只表示忙碌并挡住重复触发，不启动请求、不推断完成。
成功、失败与结果未知不是按钮的事：就地说明用 Alert，短暂反馈用 Toast，字段错误用 FieldError。
