components.decisions: 常用集合用 DataTablePattern 配置数据、列与稳定 ID；高级 TanStack 组合继续使用 DataTable。服务端模式不排序或切片传入页；完整跨页选择保存在 rowSelection ID 映射中。虚拟化只改变当前行模型的渲染窗口，不改变全选与分页范围。

en.title: DataTable
en.description: Comparison, sorting, scoped selection and optional virtualization for a caller-owned collection.
en.decisions: Configure data, columns and stable IDs with DataTablePattern; retain DataTable for advanced TanStack composition. Server mode does not sort or slice supplied pages; the complete cross-page selection lives in the rowSelection ID map. Virtualization changes only the rendered window of the current row model, preserving selection and pagination scope.
notes: Import DataTablePattern from components/data-table; its pager reuses PaginationPattern. Applications still verify cross-page object data, permissions and bulk-action scope.
TanStack is a declared optional peer; applications explicitly enable sorting, filtering and pagination models.

With sorting and selection only and no pagination, pass `autoResetAll: false` to useReactTable: its automatic reset queues a state update outside render, and when the page loads lazily through Suspense a discarded render makes React warn about updating an unmounted component.

In fixed layout, text columns without size are flexible and split the width left over by fixed and marker columns; marker columns retain their marker and cell-inset roles. Interactive content is not clipped to force a narrow width: allow actual capacity for action columns.

Virtualization retains table/thead/tbody/tr/th/td. Aria-rowcount and aria-rowindex describe the current table page including headers, without presenting server totals as loaded rows. Select-all still covers the complete current model scope.

Virtual rows are measured by stable ID and support variable actual heights. Choose an estimateRowHeight close to actual rows: distant unmeasured heights remain estimates. Explicit column widths prevent window content from changing natural layout. Disable virtualization to view or print all client rows.
One extra offscreen row retains focus and editor drafts while scrolling. When it leaves the current model, focus returns to the viewport only if that row still owned focus.

api.name: DataTablePattern
api.description: Configured sorting, page selection, active rows and pagination without issuing requests.
api.descriptionEn: Configured sorting, page selection, active rows and pagination without issuing requests.

props.name: data / columns / getRowId / emptyContent
props.description: Columns configure id, header, accessor, cell, sortable, rowHeader and numeric, with optional size/minSize/maxSize in pixels and ellipsis. Columns with size are fixed; columns without it share the remaining width. Stable getRowId is required.
props.descriptionEn: Columns configure id, header, accessor, cell, sortable, rowHeader and numeric, with optional size/minSize/maxSize in pixels and ellipsis. Columns with size are fixed; columns without it share the remaining width. Stable getRowId is required.

props.name: state / defaultState / onStateChange
props.description: A shared snapshot contains sorting, pagination, rowSelection and activeRowId; sorting and reset to page 1 produce one notification. Public page numbers start at 1.
props.descriptionEn: A shared snapshot contains sorting, pagination, rowSelection and activeRowId; sorting and reset to page 1 produce one notification. Public page numbers start at 1.

props.name: mode / pagination
props.description: Client mode sorts/slices complete data and derives totals from data.length; server mode presents supplied rows and requires totalCount, plus explicit hasNextPage when null.
props.descriptionEn: Client mode sorts/slices complete data and derives totals from data.length; server mode presents supplied rows and requires totalCount, plus explicit hasNextPage when null.

props.name: selection
props.description: Enables selection; select-all changes eligible rows on the current page while preserving outside IDs. Read state.rowSelection for the complete server selection, not the loaded-page getSelectedRowModel.
props.descriptionEn: Enables selection; select-all changes eligible rows on the current page while preserving outside IDs. Read state.rowSelection for the complete server selection, not the loaded-page getSelectedRowModel.

props.name: activeRow
props.type: ({ trigger?: 'cell', columnId: string } | { trigger: 'row' }) & { onActivate?: (row: T) => void }
props.description: By default the named column gets an activation button and its cell must be noninteractive. With trigger=row, click row content or focus the row and press Enter/Space. Nested controls, links, labels and editors do not activate the row; activation and selection remain independent.
props.descriptionEn: By default the named column gets an activation button and its cell must be noninteractive. With trigger=row, click row content or focus the row and press Enter/Space. Nested controls, links, labels and editors do not activate the row; activation and selection remain independent.

props.name: selectionAppearance
props.description: Checkbox mode removes only selected-row fill, retaining actual checkboxes and independent active-row emphasis.
props.descriptionEn: Checkbox mode removes only selected-row fill, retaining actual checkboxes and independent active-row emphasis.

props.name: virtualization
props.type: { height: number, estimateRowHeight: number, overscan?: number }
props.description: Explicitly virtualizes the current row model. Height includes the caption and header; actual row heights are measured. Dimensions must be finite and positive; overscan is a nonnegative integer, defaulting to 1.
props.descriptionEn: Explicitly virtualizes the current row model. Height includes the caption and header; actual row heights are measured. Dimensions must be finite and positive; overscan is a nonnegative integer, defaulting to 1.

props.name: stickyHeader / stickyHeaderOffset
props.description: Sticks the header to the top of the nearest scroll area: the page or Workspace content when the table fits horizontally; the table's own container for a horizontally overflowing table, the virtualization viewport, or a height / max-height set through tableProps.containerProps. stickyHeaderOffset clears a fixed bar above that area; numbers are px.
props.descriptionEn: Sticks the header to the top of the nearest scroll area: the page or Workspace content when the table fits horizontally; the table's own container for a horizontally overflowing table, the virtualization viewport, or a height / max-height set through tableProps.containerProps. stickyHeaderOffset clears a fixed bar above that area; numbers are px.

props.name: columns[].pinned / columns[].empty
props.description: pinned fixes a contiguous run of leading columns (the selection column is pinned with them; non-contiguous pins throw) and draws an edge line once scrolled sideways. empty replaces the default dash plus screen-reader 'No value' for null, undefined or empty strings in columns without cell; zero still renders. Callers distinguish unknown from not applicable through empty.
props.descriptionEn: pinned fixes a contiguous run of leading columns (the selection column is pinned with them; non-contiguous pins throw) and draws an edge line once scrolled sideways. empty replaces the default dash plus screen-reader 'No value' for null, undefined or empty strings in columns without cell; zero still renders. Callers distinguish unknown from not applicable through empty.

props.name: caption / busy / error / tableProps / native div props
props.type: ReactNode / boolean / ReactNode / DataTableProps / HTML props
props.description: While busy the old rows stay put, an indeterminate mark appears along the top edge and the pager blocks paging while keeping focus on the pressed button. error is application content with its own retry action, placed above the table as role=alert; old rows stay as well. Props target the table or composition root and never infer request outcomes.
props.descriptionEn: While busy the old rows stay put, an indeterminate mark appears along the top edge and the pager blocks paging while keeping focus on the pressed button. error is application content with its own retry action, placed above the table as role=alert; old rows stay as well. Props target the table or composition root and never infer request outcomes.

api.name: DataTable
api.description: A native two-dimensional collection.
api.descriptionEn: A native two-dimensional collection.

props.name: table / emptyContent / caption / busy / error / activeRowId / containerProps
props.description: GetRowId and at least one visible column are required; zero and caption are retained, and busy keeps valid rows without dimming them. Data rows take the hover surface on pointer hover; selected and active rows keep the deeper selected surface. error is placed above the table as role=alert and carries its own retry action.
props.descriptionEn: GetRowId and at least one visible column are required; zero and caption are retained, and busy keeps valid rows without dimming them. Data rows take the hover surface on pointer hover; selected and active rows keep the deeper selected surface. error is placed above the table as role=alert and carries its own retry action.

props.name: table.options.columns[].size / table.options.columns[].minSize / table.options.columns[].maxSize / table.options.state.columnSizing
props.description: Actual pixel widths clamped by minSize/maxSize. Any explicit dimension or nonempty columnSizing opts into fixed layout with colgroup; otherwise native auto layout remains. A column with size (or defaultColumn.size, or an entry in columnSizing) is fixed, a marker column takes its content width, and every other column is flexible: the table is 100% wide, flexible columns split the remaining space, minSize is a flexible column's floor, and without minSize the floor is 150px (TanStack's default size). The table's minimum width is the fixed columns plus the marker columns plus the flexible column count times the largest flexible floor; below it the table scrolls horizontally. maxSize does not constrain a flexible column; write size when a cap is needed. Without flexible columns the table is as wide as its columns together, and grouped headers sum visible leaf widths. Drag resizing is not built in.
props.descriptionEn: Actual pixel widths clamped by minSize/maxSize. Any explicit dimension or nonempty columnSizing opts into fixed layout with colgroup; otherwise native auto layout remains. A column with size (or defaultColumn.size, or an entry in columnSizing) is fixed, a marker column takes its content width, and every other column is flexible: the table is 100% wide, flexible columns split the remaining space, minSize is a flexible column's floor, and without minSize the floor is 150px (TanStack's default size). The table's minimum width is the fixed columns plus the marker columns plus the flexible column count times the largest flexible floor; below it the table scrolls horizontally. maxSize does not constrain a flexible column; write size when a cap is needed. Without flexible columns the table is as wide as its columns together, and grouped headers sum visible leaf widths. Drag resizing is not built in.

props.name: columnDef.meta.ellipsis
props.description: Ellipsizes noninteractive header/cell text on one line. The full text always stays in the DOM and accessible name; when actually truncated the cell becomes a keyboard stop and shows the full text in a Tooltip on focus or hover (not a native title, which keyboards and touch cannot read). Cells that fit stay out of the Tab sequence. Interactive content is not clipped. Without ellipsis cells wrap and show the full text; column widths determine capacity, so keep critical consequences visible.
props.descriptionEn: Ellipsizes noninteractive header/cell text on one line. The full text always stays in the DOM and accessible name; when actually truncated the cell becomes a keyboard stop and shows the full text in a Tooltip on focus or hover (not a native title, which keyboards and touch cannot read). Cells that fit stay out of the Tab sequence. Interactive content is not clipped. Without ellipsis cells wrap and show the full text; column widths determine capacity, so keep critical consequences visible.

props.name: columnDef.meta.numeric
props.description: A numeric column is declared by the column definition, never guessed from content: header and every cell share one alignment, at the inline end (left in RTL), with tabular figures. The Pattern column config uses the same name.
props.descriptionEn: A numeric column is declared by the column definition, never guessed from content: header and every cell share one alignment, at the inline end (left in RTL), with tabular figures. The Pattern column config uses the same name.

props.name: selectionAppearance / onRowActivate / virtualization
props.description: Selection appearance and virtualization match Pattern. Row activation receives a TanStack Row; the caller owns activeRowId. Only one row is in the Tab sequence (the last focused row, else the active row, else the first) and arrow keys move between rows. Nested interactive elements and custom data-row-activate-ignore regions are excluded, and activation never changes selection. A visible meta.rowHeader column is required to name the rows; without one it throws.
props.descriptionEn: Selection appearance and virtualization match Pattern. Row activation receives a TanStack Row; the caller owns activeRowId. Only one row is in the Tab sequence (the last focused row, else the active row, else the first) and arrow keys move between rows. Nested interactive elements and custom data-row-activate-ignore regions are excluded, and activation never changes selection. A visible meta.rowHeader column is required to name the rows; without one it throws.

props.name: columnDef.meta.rowHeader
props.description: Actual row headers use th scope=row; comparison columns are never automatically hidden. With a visible row-header column, each row's aria-labelledby points at all of its row-header cells, so the row's accessible name is their text (several row-header columns join in column order). DataTableSelectionCell names each checkbox after this row, falling back to a generic name only without a row-header column. onRowActivate without a visible row-header column throws.

components.name: date-picker
components.title: 日期输入 DatePicker
components.description: 编辑一个当地日期，或展开日历选择。
notes: 日期输入的本地显示格式由浏览器决定，提交值固定 YYYY-MM-DD。
日历选择完成后关闭；调用方拒绝变更时原日期仍保留。
没有自动修正越界值或推断提交成功；用 FieldError 表达调用方已知错误。
年份可键到 5–6 位、分段可只填一半：这些键入中间态不是值，不上报也不清空已有值，焦点离开后回到已接受的日期；只有所有分段都被清空才是清除。

api.name: DatePicker
api.description: 当前 Input、Button、Popover、Calendar 的单日期组合。
api.descriptionEn: A single-date composition of Input, Button, Popover, and Calendar.

props.name: value / defaultValue / onValueChange
props.type: Date | undefined / Date | undefined / (value, event) => void
props.description: 传了 value 属性（含 value={undefined}，表示空）即受控：调用方接受回调才改变事实。不传 value 则非受控，defaultValue 是初值，原生表单 reset 回到它，onValueChange 可省。有效年份为 1–9999。
props.descriptionEn: Passing the value prop (including value={undefined} for empty) makes it controlled: only an accepted callback changes the value. Without it the component is uncontrolled, defaultValue is the initial value, native form reset returns to it, and onValueChange is optional. Valid years are 1–9999.

props.name: min / max
props.description: 一处声明最早 / 最晚日期，同时写入原生输入的 min / max 与日历的禁用范围和可翻到的月份。与 inputProps.min/max、calendarProps.disabled/startMonth/endMonth 并存，同时给出时取交集；交集为空时开发环境警告（2026-10-12）。
props.descriptionEn: Declare the earliest and latest date once; it sets the native min / max and the calendar's disabled range and reachable months. It coexists with inputProps.min/max and calendarProps.disabled/startMonth/endMonth, and the intersection applies when both are given. An empty intersection warns in development (2026-10-12).

props.name: name / form
props.description: 真实 date input 参与原生 FormData；Field name 可提供共同命名。序列化为当地 YYYY-MM-DD。
props.descriptionEn: The real date input submits local YYYY-MM-DD. Field can provide its name; form associates an external form.

props.name: disabled / readOnly
props.description: 阻止输入与附属选择/清除；Field 禁用同样约束动作。只读值提交，禁用值不提交；只读时边界内给出「只读」说明（与 Input 同一机制）。
props.descriptionEn: Block input and auxiliary changes. Field disabled also blocks actions. Read-only values submit; disabled values do not. Read-only shows a Read only note inside the boundary, the same as Input.

props.name: inputProps
props.description: ref/render/ARIA/events/min/max/step/required 属于真实 date input。onChange 的 preventDefault 或 preventBaseUIHandler 可取消请求。

en.title: DatePicker
en.description: Edit one local date or choose it from a calendar.
en.decisions: The caller owns the local Date. Input and calendar selection request changes; clearing requests undefined. Escape closes the calendar and preserves accepted values.
notes: The browser chooses the displayed date format; submission uses YYYY-MM-DD.
Calendar selection closes the popup. Rejected controlled changes preserve the prior date.
The component does not repair bounds or infer submission success. Express known errors with FieldError.

The year can be typed to five or six digits and a segment can be left half-filled. These in-between entries are not values: they neither report nor clear the accepted date, and the input returns to it once focus leaves. Only emptying every segment clears.

components.description: 键入或在日历中选择起止日期，完整且有序时才是确认值。
notes: 两个日期输入是原生输入，显示格式随浏览器；键入与日历共用一份草稿，互相同步。
每次打开从当前输入内容建立草稿；没有默认业务长度或自动纠正。
只读时不开弹层：值在、可聚焦、可读出，不能改。

api.name: DateRangePicker
api.description: 起止两个原生日期输入、日历草稿、常用范围与明确应用动作的组合。
api.descriptionEn: A composition of two native date inputs, a calendar draft, presets, and an explicit Apply.

props.name: value / defaultValue / onValueChange
props.type: { from: Date; to: Date } | undefined / same / (value, event) => void
props.description: 传了 value 属性（含 value={undefined}）即受控；不传则非受控，defaultValue 是初值，原生表单 reset 回到它，onValueChange 可省。起点须不晚于终点；清除请求 undefined，不生成缺端点提交值。
props.descriptionEn: Passing the value prop (including value={undefined}) makes it controlled; without it the component is uncontrolled, defaultValue is the initial value, native form reset returns to it, and onValueChange is optional. Endpoints must be ordered; clearing requests undefined and a partial range never submits.

props.name: onInvalid
props.type: (draft: { from?: Date; to?: Date }, reason: "incomplete" | "order" | "bounds" | "length" | "disabled") => void
props.description: 草稿无法提交：只填一端（incomplete）、起点晚于终点（order）、超出 min / max（bounds）、天数不合 calendarProps 的 min / max（length）、端点落在禁用日或 excludeDisabled 时跨过禁用日（disabled）——与日历点选执行同一组规则。只在焦点离开整个字段且弹层关闭后通知，同时两个输入标 aria-invalid；键入是逐段进行的，过程中的暂时状态不算。库不写文案，应用用 FieldError 说明。
props.descriptionEn: The draft cannot be submitted: one endpoint only (incomplete), start after end (order), outside min / max (bounds), an interval length outside calendarProps min / max (length), or an endpoint on a disabled day, or a disabled day inside the range with excludeDisabled (disabled) — the same rules the calendar applies. Reported only after focus has left the whole field and the popup is closed, with both inputs marked aria-invalid; typing is segment by segment, so transient states do not count. The library writes no copy; the application explains with FieldError.

props.name: min / max
props.description: 一处声明最早 / 最晚日期，同时写入两个原生输入与日历的禁用范围、可翻到的月份，并使超出范围的预设不可点。与 inputProps.min/max、calendarProps.disabled 并存，取交集；交集为空时开发环境警告。
props.descriptionEn: Declare the earliest and latest date once; it sets both native inputs, the calendar's disabled range and reachable months, and disables presets that fall outside. It coexists with inputProps.min/max and calendarProps.disabled; the intersection applies, and an empty one warns in development.

props.name: presets
props.type: readonly { label: string; value: DateRangeValue | (() => DateRangeValue) }[]
props.description: 常用范围，显示在日历旁。函数形式在每次打开弹层时求值（「近 7 日」不会因页面跨过午夜而陈旧）；点击只写入草稿并翻到该月，仍须应用。草稿恰等于某一项时该项为当前（aria-pressed）。库只接收应用算好的绝对区间，不自己算相对日期。
props.descriptionEn: Common ranges beside the calendar. A function value is evaluated every time the popup opens, so Last 7 days never goes stale across midnight. Clicking only writes the draft and moves to that month; Apply is still required. The preset equal to the draft is current (aria-pressed). The library receives absolute ranges computed by the application and never computes relative dates itself.

props.name: name / form
props.description: 确认端点序列化为 name.from 与 name.to 的当地 YYYY-MM-DD。Field 可提供 name；两个日期输入本身不提交，草稿不入表单。
props.descriptionEn: Confirmed endpoints submit local YYYY-MM-DD under name.from and name.to. Field may provide the name; the two date inputs do not submit and the draft never reaches the form.

props.name: disabled / readOnly
props.description: 禁用阻止一切；只读时两个输入可聚焦、读屏读出值，但不能改值，日历入口也不开（与 Select 一致）。Field 禁用同样约束附属动作。只读确认端点仍提交，禁用排除。只读时边界内给出「只读」说明。确认范围非空且可编辑时，边界内有清除动作，清除后焦点回到起点输入。
props.descriptionEn: Disabled blocks everything. Read-only keeps both inputs focusable and readable but the value cannot change and the calendar entry does not open (as in Select). Field disabled blocks the same actions. Read-only endpoints submit; disabled endpoints are excluded. Read-only shows a Read only note in the boundary. With a confirmed range and while editable, the boundary has a clear action; focus returns to the start input after clearing.

props.name: calendarProps
props.description: min/max 指日期间隔规则（天数，与顶层的日期 min / max 不同），excludeDisabled 约束跨禁用日期。默认同日范围合法；要跨日明确传 min。mode 固定 range。
props.descriptionEn: min/max here are day-interval rules (a count of days, unlike the top-level date min / max); excludeDisabled constrains disabled days. Same-day ranges are valid by default; require a cross-day range with min. Mode is range.

props.descriptionEn: Applied to the composition root; Field provides input naming and errors.

en.title: DateRangePicker
en.description: Type or pick start and end dates; only a complete, ordered range is a confirmed value.
en.decisions: Only a complete, ordered from/to is a confirmed value. The two native date inputs and the popup calendar share one draft: typing a complete ordered range requests the change at once; one endpoint alone, a reversed range, or one out of bounds is not submitted, and after focus leaves both inputs are marked aria-invalid and onInvalid hands the explanation to the application. Endpoints are never swapped silently. Calendar picks and presets only write the draft; Cancel or Escape keeps the confirmed value and Apply requests the replacement.
notes: The two date inputs are native, so the display format follows the browser. Typing and the calendar share one draft and stay in step.
Each opening starts from what the inputs currently hold. There is no default business duration or automatic repair.
Read-only does not open the popup: the value is there, focusable and readable, but it cannot change.

notes: 应用仅在日期与时间完整时可用，点击后仍由调用方接受值。
原生 min/max/step 校验与业务可用性是独立事实；回调不是保存成功。
浏览器显示格式可随用户环境变化，提交保持无时区的本地文本。

props.name: value / defaultValue / onValueChange
props.type: string | undefined / string | undefined / (value, event) => void
props.description: 传了 value 属性（含 value={undefined}）即受控；不传则非受控，defaultValue 是初值，原生表单 reset 回到它，onValueChange 可省。完整本地日期时间：有效年份 1–9999、时间 00:00–23:59，可带秒，秒后可带 1–3 位毫秒。值比 step 更细时原样保留（同原生输入，只在原生校验里报 stepMismatch），不截断也不报错。带时区或不完整外部字符串拒绝；清除请求 undefined。
props.descriptionEn: Passing the value prop (including value={undefined}) makes it controlled; without it the component is uncontrolled, defaultValue is the initial value, native form reset returns to it, and onValueChange is optional. Complete local date/time: years 1–9999, time 00:00–23:59, optional seconds, with 1–3 fractional digits after the seconds. A value finer than step is kept as given (like the native input, which only reports stepMismatch in validation), never truncated and never an error. Zoned or incomplete external strings are rejected; clearing requests undefined.

props.name: min / max
props.description: 同样的无时区文本。一处声明同时写入原生输入的 min / max、日历的禁用日期与可翻到的月份、边界当天时间输入的 min / max，并使超出范围的草稿不能应用。与 inputProps.min/max、calendarProps.disabled 并存，取交集；交集为空时开发环境警告（2026-10-12）。
props.descriptionEn: Unzoned text of the same form. Declare once: it sets the native min / max, the calendar's disabled days and reachable months, the time input's min / max on a boundary day, and blocks applying a draft outside the range. It coexists with inputProps.min/max and calendarProps.disabled; the intersection applies, and an empty one warns in development (2026-10-12).

props.name: disabled / readOnly

With a value and while editable, the boundary has a clear action and focus returns to the input after clearing.

props.name: columns
props.description: 并排的「名称 · 值」组数上限，正整数。按 DOM 顺序逐行排开（先横后纵），读屏顺序与视觉顺序一致；同一列的名称共用一条值的起始线。容器放不下时按容器实宽（不看视口）退回更少列：一组至少 12 材（默认 240px，预设）。

Items flow row by row in DOM order, so reading order matches visual order, and names in one column share a value start line. props.name: layout
props.description: stacked：名称在左、值在右成对。inline：每个条目是名称在上、值在下的一小块，块与块横排并随宽度换行（columns 给出时按列数分格，最小块宽 8 材，预设）。两者都是 dl > div > dt + dd。
props.descriptionEn: stacked: names on the left, values on the right. inline: each item is a small block with the name above the value, blocks flowing horizontally and wrapping with the width (with columns they are split into that many cells, at least 8 modules wide, a preset). components.name: dialog
components.title: 对话框 Dialog
components.description: 接管整个工作面，完成当前编辑或决定后返回。
notes: 长内容放进 DialogPanel：主操作在页脚始终可见；不用 DialogPanel 的写法仍是整面板滚动。
不需要阻断时使用就地表单或 Popover；必须明确回应的危险决定使用 AlertDialog。
草稿策略由应用持有。关闭、放弃草稿、保存和撤销分别命名。
危险决定用 AlertDialog，后果写在它的说明里；按钮不承载后果。
无触发者的程序打开也须指定有意义的 finalFocus。
共享层级按真实开启顺序使新工作面高于旧面候选；调用方覆盖 zIndex 可破坏默认关系。
ARIA实测驱动的契约收窄：Portal固定keepMounted=false，JS传true也不保留关闭DOM。应用显式持有草稿；Primitive自行组合仍有原语keepMounted隔离缺陷。

en.decisions: Closing ends the presentation and returns to the trigger; it does not imply saving. The caller owns input values and subsequent actions.
notes: Put long content in DialogPanel so the primary action stays visible in the footer; without DialogPanel the whole panel still scrolls.

Programmatic opening without a trigger needs a meaningful finalFocus target.

ARIA evidence narrows the contract: Portal forces keepMounted=false, even for JavaScript callers passing true. The application holds drafts explicitly. Direct Primitive composition still has the upstream retained-portal isolation defect.

en.title: Field
en.description: Connect one value's name, control, description, and caller-supplied errors.
en.decisions: Supply invalid and error content separately. Field connects names and errors without validating or inferring submission results.
notes: Field excludes validate, validationMode, validationDebounceTime, and actionsRef. Pass results from application validation; use the full FieldPrimitive composition for primitive-managed validation.
FieldError renders nothing without supplied content. Standalone content does not associate with another control.
Unregistered self-named controls need explicit aria-labelledby and aria-describedby. FieldTitle does not supply those connections.
Import Fieldset / FieldsetLegend from components/fieldset. FieldSet / FieldLegend aliases have been removed.
Styles consume field-gap, field-group-gap, and text profiles. Their numerical values are centralized presets.

A Field builds one labelable scope: every control in it receives the same id and the same label. Radio and SegmentedControlItem open their own scope inside a Field, so they need no FieldItem; an item already wrapped in FieldItem is not wrapped again, so the FieldLabel beside it still works. Compositions that use FieldPrimitive.Item directly are not detected; do not nest another scope.

components.name: file-upload
components.title: 文件输入 FileUpload
components.description: 选择或拖入本地文件，保留已接受集合与真实拒绝原因。
notes: 只需要「点一下选文件、选完立即交给应用」（如工具条上的导入）时用 FileTrigger；FileUpload 保留已接受集合并随表单提交。清空选择用受控 `value={[]}`，表单 reset 会自动清空——不另设 reset 方法。
粘贴文件：焦点在组件内（选择入口、移除按钮等）时，剪贴板里的文件与拖入同一条规则；组件内的文本框、纯文字粘贴、只读与禁用不受影响。不在 document 上全局监听。
拖偏时浏览器会直接打开文件并离开页面：文档级拖放守卫是全局副作用，不进组件，由应用在页面上对 dragover 与 drop 调用 preventDefault（落在 FileUpload 内的事件不受影响，组件自己处理）。
对象身份决定集合成员；不凭同名/大小猜文件内容相同。移除后可重新选择同一文件；聚焦行移除回相邻动作或 chooser，受控拒绝不夺焦点。
Field 保留 Label/error/disabled 连接；实际 chooser 的 name/value 隔离，避免提交草稿；必填不交给原生 required（会恒 invalid），见 required。
需要支持 formdata 的浏览器；jsdom 事件桥接不等于已验证原生 FormData 构造行为。
规则值是应用约束，列表/拖放布局是选择，样式读现有角色，无额外数值 token。拖放区即整个组件：常驻一条与 Input 同一 token 的边界，拖入时换成焦点色并铺底。
选择入口只显示操作名称，原生 chooser 清空用于重选；已接受文件事实以独立集合呈现。装饰 span 不创建第二交互入口。

api.name: FileUpload
api.description: 原生 file Input、拖放、已接受列表与真实规则验证的组合。
api.descriptionEn: A native file input composed with dropping, accepted files, and real rule validation.

props.name: value / defaultValue / onValueChange
props.type: readonly File[] / readonly File[] / (files, details) => void
props.description: 受控或非受控接受集合，保留 File 引用。details 含 select/drop/paste/remove、added/removed/event/cancel()；受控拒绝或取消不改变提交集合。
props.descriptionEn: Controlled or uncontrolled accepted files, retaining File references. details includes select/drop/paste/remove, added, removed, event, and cancel(). Refusal or cancellation preserves submitted files.

props.name: accept / maxSize / maxFiles
props.description: 扩展名/MIME规则、每文件字节数、集合数量。大小与数量为非负安全整数，省略不限制；按 type/size/count 的实际首个失败理由拒绝，已知外部集合不静默纠正。
props.descriptionEn: Extension/MIME rules, bytes per file, and collection count. Size and count are nonnegative safe integers; omitted means unlimited. Reject with the first actual type/size/count failure; external sets are not silently repaired.

props.name: multiple
props.description: 默认是集合选择；false 的集合容量最多1，已有文件须先移除才能加入另一个，不隐式替换。
props.descriptionEn: Defaults to collection selection. false limits capacity to one; remove an existing file before adding another, with no implicit replacement.

props.name: validate
props.description: 返回文案即拒绝，与类型、大小、数量走同一条通道（onReject，就地列出，reason 为 "custom" 并带 message）。在类型与大小之后、数量之前判断；只看 File 本身，内容校验与查重属于应用。
props.descriptionEn: Return a message to reject, through the same channel as type, size and count (onReject, listed in place, reason "custom" with a message). Evaluated after type and size and before count; it sees only the File, and content checks and de-duplication belong to the application.

props.name: onReject
props.description: 真实 type/size/count/directory 拒绝与 validate 的自定义拒绝；拒绝项可关闭提示，但不冒充已接受文件。拖入文件夹以 directory 拒绝（浏览器把文件夹作为大小 0、类型为空的伪文件放进 files，只有 webkitGetAsEntry 能识别）。
props.descriptionEn: Actual type/size/count/directory rejections and validate's custom ones. Dismissing feedback does not make rejected files accepted. A dropped folder is rejected as directory (browsers put it in files as a size-0, type-less pseudo file; only webkitGetAsEntry can recognise it).

props.name: name / form
props.description: chooser 不带最终 name；Field 可提供名称，公开 formdata 事件 append 已接受 File，不覆盖同名其它字段。显式 form 支持外部表单。
props.descriptionEn: The chooser has no final name. Field may supply it; the public formdata event appends accepted Files without replacing other same-name fields. form supports external forms.

props.name: required
props.description: 至少要有一个已接受的文件才能提交。不用原生 required（原生文件输入在每次选择后即清空，永远判为未填），而是按已接受集合是否为空设置输入的 customValidity：空则浏览器拦下提交并说明，选中文件后即满足；输入带 aria-required。只读与禁用不参与校验。无效的呈现仍由 Field 的 invalid 与 FieldError 表达。
props.descriptionEn: At least one accepted file is needed to submit. Native required is not used (the native file input is cleared after every selection and would always read as empty); the input's customValidity follows whether the accepted set is empty, so the browser stops the submit and says why, and choosing a file satisfies it. The input carries aria-required. Read-only and disabled skip validation. How invalid looks is still Field's invalid and FieldError.

props.name: disabled / readOnly
props.description: 阻止选择、拖放和移除；Field/原生 fieldset 禁用同样约束。只读文件继续提交，禁用排除。原生 reset 未取消时非受控恢复初始 defaultValue，受控值保留。
props.descriptionEn: Block selecting, dropping, and removing, including Field/native fieldset disabled. Read-only submits; disabled is excluded. Uncanceled native reset restores initial uncontrolled defaultValue and retains controlled values.

props.name: getStatus
props.description: 调用方真实 waiting/in-progress/failed/unknown/success 与可见 label。只有 in-progress 可提供 {value, min?, max}；max 是调用方已知分母，null 为不定进度。
props.descriptionEn: Caller-provided waiting/in-progress/failed/unknown/success and a visible label. Only in-progress accepts {value,min?,max}; max is a known denominator and null is indeterminate.

props.name: renderFileActions
props.description: 应用的实际恢复/核对入口，组件不自动执行；本地移除不表示取消上传或删除服务端对象。
props.descriptionEn: Real application recovery/check actions, never executed automatically. Local removal does not imply canceling an upload or deleting a server object.

props.name: inputProps / render / ref / ARIA / events
props.description: 选择动作与编辑边界共用一套几何（跟随密度轴）；Input 出口支持 render/ref/events。必填用上面的 required，不经 inputProps。
props.descriptionEn: The chooser shares one geometry with the editing boundary (density axis). Input supports render, refs, and events. For a required set use the required prop above, not inputProps.

en.title: FileUpload
en.description: Choose or drop local files, retaining accepted files and real rejection reasons.
en.decisions: The component manages local selection only. The application supplies upload states, progress denominators, failure, unknown results, and recovery. It sends no requests, invents no progress, and infers no result from a Promise.
notes: Use FileTrigger when you only need to press a button, choose files, and hand them to the application at once (such as an import in a toolbar); FileUpload retains the accepted set and submits with the form. To clear the selection, use controlled `value={[]}`; a form reset clears it automatically, so there is no reset method.

Pasted files: while focus is inside the component (chooser, remove buttons, ...) files on the clipboard follow the same rules as dropped ones; text inputs inside it, plain-text paste, read-only and disabled are unaffected. No listener is placed on the document.

A drop that misses opens the file in the browser and leaves the page. A document-level drop guard is a global side effect and stays out of the component: the application calls preventDefault on dragover and drop at page level (events landing in a FileUpload are handled by the component).

Object identity determines membership; equal names/sizes do not imply equal content. Removed files can be reselected. Removing a focused row returns to a neighboring action or chooser; controlled refusal preserves focus.

Field retains label/error/disabled links. The actual chooser isolates name and value to avoid draft submission; required is not left to native required (which would stay invalid), see the required prop.
Requires browser formdata support. A jsdom event bridge does not verify native FormData construction.

Rules are application constraints; list/drop layout is a choice. Styles use existing roles without new numeric tokens. The drop zone is the whole component: it carries a permanent boundary from the same token as Input, switching to the focus colour with a fill while a drag is over it.
The chooser displays its action name and clears for reselection. The separate list expresses accepted files. Its decorative span creates no second interaction entry.

api.name: focusFirstInvalid(form)
api.description: 纯函数：按文档顺序聚焦 form 里第一个无效字段并 scrollIntoView({ block: "nearest" })，找到返回 true。无效 = aria-invalid="true" 或原生 :invalid 的 input/select/textarea；落点是用户看得见、键盘本来就能走到的部件（Select 触发器、Checkbox/Switch 的标记、Radio、Slider 滑块、OtpField 输入等），跳过禁用、aria-hidden、不可见与 tabindex=-1 的隐藏原生副本。由应用在设置完 Field.invalid 后调用（先让 aria-invalid 渲染，再调用，例如放进 effect）；Form 自身不调用它，默认行为不变。
api.descriptionEn: A pure function: focuses the first invalid field in document order and calls scrollIntoView({ block: "nearest" }); returns true when found. Invalid means aria-invalid="true" or a native :invalid input/select/textarea. It lands on the part the user can see and reach by keyboard (Select trigger, Checkbox/Switch mark, Radio, Slider thumb, OtpField input, ...), skipping disabled, aria-hidden, invisible, and tabindex=-1 hidden native copies. The application calls it after setting Field.invalid (let aria-invalid render first, e.g. in an effect); Form never calls it, so default behaviour is unchanged.

components.name: heatmap
components.title: 两维度的量 Heatmap
components.description: 两个类别维度上的量，例如「星期 × 时段」的同步热度；单色顺序色阶（第一色由淡到足）或应用声明的分档，可用键盘逐格读，另有按需展开的数据表。
notes: 整张图是一个 grid，只有一个 Tab 停靠点；每个格是只读的 gridcell，aria-label 直接给出行、列、数值（有分档时再加档名）或未知原因，不依赖悬停就能读到。
悬停/聚焦读数只增强，不替代可聚焦格自身的名称与数据表。
相邻格之间 2px 纸色空隙，与柱状、堆叠柱同一机制。
少于两行或两列会抛出错误：那是 Chart 的 bar，不是网格。
分档的边界与好坏由应用声明；组件不从数值猜，也不计算行尾汇总。

props.name: levels
props.type: readonly { label: string; from?: number; tone?: Tone }[]
props.description: 分档，2 到 5 档。第一档不写 from（覆盖更小的值），其后每档 from 严格递增；档名非空且互不相同，违反抛错。给出后格子按所在的档上色，图例是各档的色块加档名；没有 tone 的档取墨，有 tone 的档取该类别色，浓淡随档次递增。未知格不属于任何一档。

components.decisions: 行列都是类别轴，不是数据系列——没有身份要区分，只有量的大小，因此只用一种色相：数据是色，取第一色（花青）与纸调和的 12% 到足色。未知/不适用格用清墨斜线纹，不进色阶，避免与真实的小量值混淆。给出 levels 时改按档上色：档由应用声明，浓淡随档次递增，去掉色相仍读得出次序；档名进入格子的名称与读数。

en.title: Heatmap
en.description: A quantity over two categorical dimensions, such as sync activity by weekday and hour; a single-hue sequential scale (the first series color, light to full) or application-declared levels, readable cell by cell from the keyboard, with an on-demand data table.
en.decisions: Rows and columns are both categorical axes, not data series — there is no identity to distinguish, only magnitude, so it uses one hue: data is color, the first series color (huaqing) mixed with paper from 12% to full. Unknown/not-applicable cells carry a diagonal ink hatch instead of a scale step, so they are never mistaken for a small real value. With levels, cells take the color of their level: the application declares the levels, depth grows with the level so the order survives without hue, and the level name joins each cell's name and the readout.
notes: The chart is one grid with a single tab stop; every cell is a read-only gridcell whose aria-label states the row, column, value (plus the level name when levels are set) or unavailable reason, reachable without hovering.
Hover/focus readouts only enhance; they never replace the focusable cell's own name or the data table.
Adjacent cells carry the same 2px surface-color gap as bars and stacked bars.
Fewer than two rows or columns throws: that is a Chart bar, not a grid.
Level boundaries and what counts as bad are declared by the application; the component neither guesses from values nor computes the row summary.

props.name: segments
props.description: 离散的 n 级：轨道按 n 个等宽格分开，格间留 2px 透明空隙。n 为 2 以上的整数；(value − min) 必须是 (max − min)/n 的整数倍，否则抛 RangeError。级别名用 getAriaValueText 给出。

en.description: Edit an optional number and adjust it by a declared step.

notes: The default width holds two steppers and about eight digits (--qy-number-width). Pass className="w-full" to NumberField to fill the container, the same way as Select. Stepper buttons are as wide as the control's inner height, following the touch-target height under coarse pointers.
Read-only shows a read-only note below the control; steppers are hidden but keep their place.
FieldLabel names the real input; FieldDescription states range and step.
The wrapper fixes allowOutOfRange=true and does not silently correct direct edits.
An out-of-range value is not a save failure. The caller provides invalid.
This rebuild changes the shared boundary and size profiles. Browser focus and contrast require separate checks.

与 FieldLabel、FieldDescription、FieldError 共处；分段本身对辅助技术隐藏。

api.descriptionEn: Segmented presentation of Input with one Field registration.

props.name: length
props.description: 必填正整数，以 Unicode code point 计。超长用户插入整次拒绝并说明；外部值完整呈现，不截断。
props.descriptionEn: Required positive integer, counted as Unicode code points. Over-capacity insertions are rejected whole with feedback. External values are shown in full.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: 受控或非受控文本，保留前导零。
props.descriptionEn: Controlled or uncontrolled text; leading zeros remain.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: 请求文本变化；受控调用方拒绝更新时原值不变。输入法合成期间按输入原样回显，合成结束后才按长度校验。
props.descriptionEn: Requests a text change. A controlled caller may retain the previous value. During IME composition the text is echoed as typed; the length rule applies once composition ends.

props.name: normalizeValue
props.description: 键入与粘贴的文本先经它归一化，再按 length 校验；返回值就是写入的文本。验证码常以分组形式送达（123 456、123-456），WCAG 3.3.8 不允许靠拒绝粘贴来为难人，所以默认去掉分隔。限定字符集用 text => text.replace(/\D/g, "")；码本身含连字符时传 text => text。
props.descriptionEn: Typed and pasted text is normalised first, then checked against length; the result is what is written. Codes often arrive grouped (123 456, 123-456) and WCAG 3.3.8 forbids refusing a paste, so whitespace and hyphens are stripped by default. Restrict the character set with text => text.replace(/\D/g, ""); pass text => text when the code itself contains hyphens.

props.name: inputMode / autoComplete
props.description: inputMode 由真实字符范围决定；type 始终 text，不自动转换为数值。
props.descriptionEn: Choose inputMode for the character set. The input type remains text.

props.name: render / ref / className / style / ARIA / events
props.description: 全部属于真实 input；render 必须保持 input 语义、受控值和事件。分段本身固定 dir=ltr（验证码是数字或字母串），不随页面方向反转。
props.descriptionEn: Applied to the real input. Render must retain input semantics, its controlled value, and events. The segments are fixed dir=ltr (a code is a digit or letter string) and do not mirror with the page.

props.name: controlClassName
props.description: 调整分段容器的位置与布局。
props.descriptionEn: Styles the segmented container's placement and layout.

props.name: disabled / readOnly / name / form / required
props.description: 禁用不提交；只读可聚焦、复制与提交。
props.descriptionEn: Disabled text does not submit. Read-only text remains focusable, copyable, and submitted.

键入与粘贴的文本先经过它，再按 `length` 校验；返回值就是写入的文本。

en.title: OtpField
en.description: Present a fixed-length text value in segments.
en.decisions: One real text input owns the caret and selection. Leading zeros remain intact. Filling the length reports no verification result; the application owns checking and requests.
notes: Clicking a segment selects its character. An empty segment places the caret at the end. The real input overlays the segments invisibly and receives the pointer, so a touch long-press can reach the system paste menu.
Compose with FieldLabel, FieldDescription, and FieldError. Visual segments are hidden from assistive tech.
This rebuild chooses one segmented input and does not restore a prior segmented API.
Mobile autofill, real IME, assistive tech, and focus contrast need browser/device verification.

en.title: PasswordInput
en.description: Enter a password and switch to plain text to check it.
en.decisions: PasswordInput is a composition, not a mode of Input: the input and a show-password toggle sit inside one editing boundary (InputGroup), both public parts. The input only holds the value; the toggle is a separate action on the boundary with the stable name “Show password”, its state expressed by aria-pressed. The toggle changes no content and submits no form; strength, rules and validation come from the application.
notes: Never block pasting or password-manager autofill (WCAG 3.3.8, Accessible Authentication): the component has no paste, drop or autofill-disabling handling, and callers should not add one through onPaste preventDefault, autoComplete="off", or by splitting the input into several fields.
Replace Input type="password" with PasswordInput; Input's visibilityToggle / visible / defaultVisible / onVisibleChange / showLabel are removed.

en.title: Popover
en.description: A trigger-bound non-modal popup for local actions and supplementary information.
en.decisions: Closing hides the popup; it does not complete submission or undo. The application owns drafts and results. Keep essential consequences on the persistent work surface.
notes: Popover is always non-modal. Use Dialog or AlertDialog for a blocking decision.
Outside clicks retain focus on the clicked control; keyboard dismissal returns to the trigger.
The default body portal cannot inherit the trigger's local DOM context. Mount container before opening.
Base UI owns open state, focus and positioning; motion.css owns entry and exit motion.

When the trigger renders an existing bounded control such as render={<Button />}, that control owns focus and border; PopoverTrigger only adds the hit area. Only a bare trigger draws its own border and inset focus line.

en.title: Proportion
en.description: Which parts make up a whole and how much each takes.
en.decisions: Length rather than angle carries the share, so there is no pie; it uses the same groove as Meter. Two to five parts take the validated series order, and the remainder is the groove itself. The legend states names, values and percentages as the full text equivalent; legend="hidden" only moves it off screen (assistive technology still reads it), it is never removed. Parts may declare a status tone: all or none, and no tone twice.

examples.title: 已有承载面与文中的组件

whenToUse: 展示一段已经渲染好的长文或 Markdown 结果：帮助文章、更新日志、AI 回复、文档正文。
avoid: Prose 不解析 Markdown 字符串；把原始文本交给具体渲染器，渲染结果再放进 Prose。
短小的字段说明或摘要用 Text；Prose 是给整段长文排版，不是通用的富文本容器。
composition: children 是渲染器产出的原生元素树，或经审查的 dangerouslySetInnerHTML；Prose 只加一层 className。
文章里直接放库组件：带 data-slot 的元素及其内部不排版。自己画的一段内容加上 data-slot，就声明了它不是正文。
div、section 这类容器子块不进入。要让容器里的标题与段落也成文，用 render 把这个容器本身做成一篇 Prose。
页面已经有承载面（Card、文档站的纸）时保持默认（不带框）：只排版，不再画第二张纸；栏宽与内缘读 --qy-prose-column、--qy-prose-inset，承载面可以取同一组值。文章独自成篇、没有承载面时才设 framed。
h1 与紧随的一段导语放进 header：两者相隔一个字段间距，导语读淡墨。
表格读与 Table 组件相同的视觉规则（清染表头/表尾、行高、数字列等宽），行内代码读 Typography 的 Code 规则，链接读 Link 的 linkClassName，不另起一套画法。

library: 标题、段落、列表、引用、代码、表格、分隔线、图片、键位、详情框的排版与墨阶。
application: Markdown 解析、内容本身、任务列表勾选框的完成事实、脚注与链接目标。

responsive: 栏宽 38 材（760px），不随视口拉宽；段落、列表与引用的行长止于 40 个正文字（640px），代码块与表格可以用满栏。纸的内缘 2 材，窄屏收紧到面板内缘。三个值都是预设，入口是 --qy-prose-column、--qy-prose-measure、--qy-prose-inset。
很宽的表格目前不会在 Prose 内独立横向滚动（纸的圆角需要 overflow-hidden 而非 overflow-x-auto），只能按单元格自然换行——已知缺口，非默认画法缺失。
customization: 使用公开 render/ref/className/style 与原生属性；不混用主题三轴。

sourceFacts.extraction: TypeScript AST for export signatures; props resolved with the TypeScript type checker (typeApi). Missing signatures remain UNVERIFIED.

components.decisions: Prose 不解析 Markdown、不内置渲染器：调用方用任意工具（react-markdown、MDX、服务端 HTML）产出原生元素，Prose 只给直接子块里的原生文本元素（header、h1–h4、p、ul/ol 含任务列表、blockquote、pre、table、figure、details、hr、img）以及这些子块之内的原生元素（strong/em、a、行内代码、kbd、figcaption、summary 等）排版，不改写它们的结构或属性。带 data-slot 的元素与它的内部不进入，所以文章里可以直接放组件与演示。标题三级取页面已有的文字档（h1 展示、h2 标题、h3 章节），与官网文档同一套（2026-10-12 裁决）。

en.title: Prose
en.description: Typesets already-rendered Markdown or rich text: headings, paragraphs, lists, quotes, code and tables read existing text tiers and ink roles. It only typesets by default, with no frame; give it a reading paper with framed when the article stands alone with no surface of its own.
en.decisions: Prose neither parses Markdown nor bundles a renderer: callers use any tool (react-markdown, MDX, server-rendered HTML) to produce native elements, and Prose typesets only the native text blocks among its direct children (header, h1–h4, p, ul/ol including task lists, blockquote, pre, table, figure, details, hr, img) and the native elements inside them (strong/em, a, inline code, kbd, figcaption, summary and so on), without rewriting their structure or attributes. An element carrying data-slot, and everything inside it, is left alone, so components and live examples can sit directly in an article. The three heading ranks read the page's existing text tiers (h1 display, h2 title, h3 chapter), the same scale as the documentation site (ruling of 2026-10-12).
notes: Ships no built-in copy strings; does not go through useUILocale.
Ink roles and the paper swap automatically between light and dark; callers do not handle this.
The typesetting rules sit in the stylesheet's components layer: any utility class on an element in the article overrides them, with no !important.
Chinese paragraphs are justified and break lines under the strict rule; this follows the element's lang, so the page must declare its language correctly.

Known limit: a second Prose nested through a component inside a native text block of an outer Prose (a Prose in a Card in a figure, for example) does not get its inline elements typeset; place it in a div or section instead.

props.description: Whether it brings its own reading paper (surface, hairline, radius, inset and column limit). False by default: it only typesets and the surrounding surface is the paper (no boxed specimens, no redundant frames); set true when the article stands alone.

props.descriptionEn: Forward attributes, events and refs to the actual element; children are content the caller has already rendered.

whenToUse: Present an already-rendered long-form or Markdown result: a help article, a changelog entry, an AI reply, or documentation body copy.
avoid: Prose does not parse Markdown strings; hand raw text to an actual renderer first and place its output inside Prose.
Use Text for short field descriptions or summaries; Prose typesets a whole long-form passage, not a general rich-text container.
composition: Children are the renderer's native element tree, or reviewed dangerouslySetInnerHTML; Prose only adds one className.

Place library components directly in an article: an element carrying data-slot, and everything inside it, is not typeset. Put data-slot on a block you draw yourself to declare that it is not running text.
Container children such as div and section are not entered. To typeset the headings and paragraphs inside one, make that container itself a Prose through render.

Where the page already has a surface (a Card, the documentation paper) keep the default (no frame): it only typesets and draws no second paper; the column and inset come from --qy-prose-column and --qy-prose-inset, so the surface can read the same values. Set framed only when the article stands alone with no surface of its own.
Put the h1 and the lead paragraph that follows it in a header: they sit one field gap apart and the lead reads in muted ink.

Tables read the same visual rules as the Table component (washed header/footer bands, row height, tabular numeric cells); inline code reads Typography's Code rule; links read Link's linkClassName — none of these get a second drawing.

library: Typesetting and ink roles for headings, paragraphs, lists, quotes, code, tables, rules, images, keys and disclosure widgets.
application: Markdown parsing, the content itself, task-list completion facts, footnotes and link destinations.

responsive: The column is 38 材 (760px) and does not widen with the viewport; paragraphs, lists and quotes stop at a measure of 40 reading characters (640px), while code blocks and tables may use the whole column. The paper's inset is 2 材 and tightens to the panel padding on narrow screens. All three are presets, set through --qy-prose-column, --qy-prose-measure and --qy-prose-inset.

A very wide table does not yet scroll independently inside Prose (the paper's rounded corners need overflow-hidden rather than overflow-x-auto), so cells simply wrap — a known gap, not a missing default treatment.
customization: 使用公开 render/ref/className/style 与原生属性；不混用主题三轴。

en.title: Resizable
en.description: Draggable separators between two or more panels that change how the space is shared.
en.decisions: A separator changes only the two panels around it; the rest stay put and the shares always add up to 100. Pixel limits ("240px") are converted with the measured group length and do not apply when no length can be measured. Collapsing belongs to the panel: it is triggered by the pointer passing the midpoint between collapsed and minimum size, or by Enter on the separator. What the content does when collapsed, and how it is reopened, is up to the application.
notes: The 10% arrow step is a preset; APG does not prescribe one.
The hit area is 8px with a fine pointer and 44px with a coarse one; only a line is visible.
Panels clip overflow: put content that needs to scroll in a ScrollArea.

methods: Space supports the task （布白有用）
whenToUse: The share between two blocks side by side (or stacked) should be adjusted by the user, such as a list on the left and details on the right.
avoid: Use plain flex or grid when the shares are fixed, and Separator when only a dividing line is needed.
composition: Put content that scrolls itself in the panels (ScrollArea, Tree, DataTable). Name the separator after the main panel it resizes, for example "List".

library: Solving and clamping each panel's share, dragging and keys, collapse state, writing direction.
application: Whether the layout is persisted (onLayout / layout), how a collapsed panel is reopened, and the panel content.

responsive: Shares are relative to the group. Whether a narrow screen stacks the panels or switches to a single pane is up to the application; the component does not swap layouts.
customization: Line width and ink read the system line width and ink ladder; the hit area and the keyboard step are presets. className merges last and native attributes forward.

components.name: scatter-chart
components.title: 两量关系 ScatterChart
components.description: 两个数值量之间的关系；全比较形式，1 至 3 个系列，同源的散点图、命名的双轴与按需展开的数据表。
notes: 绘图区对读屏隐藏（aria-hidden）：标记只是形状，没有可读的名称与值；数据由「查看数据」展开的等价表承担，系列区分另有图例文字与标记形状，不只靠色相。
超过 3 个系列会抛出错误：全比较形式任意两点都可能相邻，色觉校验比相邻校验更严，更多系列应合并为「其他」或改用小图版面拆分。
点的命中区≥24px，大于 8px 的可见标记，指针不必正中标记。
x、y 轴域按实际数据范围加少量留白，不强制从零起——散点不是从基线生长的柱。
悬停读数只增强，不替代按需展开的等价数据表。

components.decisions: x、y 都是数值轴——这是散点的任务定义，不是违反「永远一个数值轴」；该禁令禁止的是同一类别轴上叠两条不同量纲的 Y 轴制造虚假相关。全比较形式最多 3 个系列，超过应合并为「其他」或拆成多图。

en.title: ScatterChart
en.description: The relationship between two numeric quantities; an all-pairs form with one to three series, a same-source scatter plot, named axes and an on-demand data table.
en.decisions: Both x and y are value axes by the task's own definition, not a violation of "always one value axis" — that ban targets stacking two different-unit Y-axes on one shared category axis, which fabricates correlation. As an all-pairs form it accepts at most three series; more should fold into "Other" or split into separate charts.
notes: The plot is hidden from assistive technology (aria-hidden): markers are only shapes with no readable name or value; the equivalent table opened by "View data" carries the data, and series are told apart by legend text and marker shape, not hue alone.

More than three series throws: as an all-pairs form any two points may sit adjacent, so its color-vision check is stricter than an adjacent check; fold extra series into "Other" or split into small multiples.
Each point's hit area is at least 24px, larger than its visible 8px marker; the pointer need not land dead-center.
The x and y domains pad slightly around the actual data range rather than forcing a zero baseline — a scatter point does not grow from a baseline like a bar.
Hover readouts only enhance; they never replace the on-demand equivalent data table.

en.title: Scroll area
en.description: Native scrolling with an optional composition of draggable scrollbars.
notes: Division of labor: use ScrollArea by default (one element, native scrollbars that follow platform settings); reach for ScrollAreaRoot / ScrollAreaViewport / ScrollAreaContent / ScrollAreaScrollbar / ScrollAreaThumb / ScrollAreaCorner only when the design requires drawn scrollbars. ScrollArea retains its single native viewport and ref contract; native scrollbar visibility respects platform preferences.

Consumer layout owns dimensions. Use ScrollArea for complete rendering and VirtualList for long collections.

en.description: Enter a search term and clear it in one step.

It holds the search term only: it sends no request, does not decide when to search, and shows no results.

en.title: Section
en.description: A page block without a border, named by its title; the title and its actions share one row.

A section is named by its title: SectionTitle hands its id to Section as aria-labelledby, and without a title no reference is made. A count is not a part of its own; it is a run of muted tabular digits inside the title.
notes: The caller decides the distance and any line between sections; a section draws none.

components.name: select
components.title: 选择器 Select
components.description: 从可收起的候选列表中取一个值。
notes: FieldLabel 命名触发器，FieldError 关联错误；SelectGroupLabel 命名候选分组。
null 是未选择，空字符串（""）和 0 都是合法的候选值。选了值为 "" 的候选，触发器显示它的 label，不显示占位，data-placeholder 也不出现；null 才显示占位。用 "" 表示「不限」「无」这类真实选项时，要在 items 里给它可读的 label。注意原生表单会把 null 与 "" 都序列化为空字符串，服务端需要区分时用别的值，或在应用侧另存选择与否。
只读保留当前值并在触发器上给出「只读」说明，禁用项不能选取。
触发器默认不拉满容器；要拉满时给 SelectTrigger className="w-full"。没有 items 时无法预知候选名称，宽度只随当前显示的内容。
候选来自请求时：用 loading 表示请求中，用 error 放入失败说明与重试动作；没有子项且二者皆无才显示「没有可选项」。
自身 Positioner 消费共享 popup 层级，父工作面内候选高于该工作面；positionerProps 保留调用方 style/ref/render。

props.description: 值到名称的映射；显式空字符串候选也要提供可读 label。触发器宽度由其中最长的名称决定，选另一项时不会伸缩。

en.description: Choose one value from a collapsible set of options.
en.decisions: Highlight marks position; selection changes the value. No selection does not choose the first item automatically. Use RadioGroup for side-by-side comparison.
notes: FieldLabel names the trigger, FieldError associates errors, and SelectGroupLabel names candidate groups.

null is no selection; the empty string ("") and zero are both valid candidate values. Selecting a candidate whose value is "" shows its label in the trigger, not the placeholder, and data-placeholder is absent; only null shows the placeholder. When "" stands for a real option such as "Any" or "None", give it a readable label in items. Native forms serialize both null and "" as an empty string; when the server must tell them apart, use another value or keep the has-chosen fact in the application.
Read-only retains the current value and shows a read-only note on the trigger; disabled candidates cannot be selected.
The trigger does not fill its container by default; pass className="w-full" to SelectTrigger to do so. Without items the candidate names are unknown, so the width follows only what is displayed.
For request-backed candidates, use loading while the request runs and error for the failure explanation and retry action; "No options" appears only with no children and neither state.
Its Positioner consumes shared popup layers; candidates inside a parent workspace sit above it. positionerProps retain caller styles/refs/render.

en.title: SeverityMark
en.description: An ordered level shown as a number of filled cells, named by the application.
en.decisions: The level is carried by the number of filled cells and tone is only an accompanying category: two levels with the same cell count and different hues cannot be told apart once the name is hidden, so different levels take different level values. The library ships no level words and infers no name from the number; label is required. With no level, omit the mark: level has no 0.
notes: A screen reader reads the name once: the cells and the visible name stay out of the accessibility tree.
The level does not rely on color: without hue, solid filled cells and outlined empty cells still give the level.
In forced colors filled cells are solid CanvasText and empty cells are an outline; tone hues collapse to one color.

components.name: sidebar
components.title: 侧栏导航 Sidebar
components.description: 长期导航、收起为图标 rail 与二级子级。
notes: 展开宽度默认读 --qy-sidebar-width（两侧内缘 + 条目内缩 + 一枚图标 + 间隔 + 12 个汉字的标签容量；12 字是预设），调用方的 w-* 仍可覆盖；收起宽度由库按一个填值控件高加两侧内缩给出，始终保留可见 Toggle。
当前项用圆角的面标出，比悬停面深一级，并加中等字重：悬停是一级清染，当前是一级清墨，指针经过的行不会和当前项长得一样；字重是不靠颜色的第二信号。当前项不画线（用户裁决：直线与圆角面不在同一项上并用）；二级条目左侧的引导线只表达归属，当前项不加深它。
二级入口的展开记号收起时朝内、展开时朝下，与 Tree 的分支同一画法；父项没有图标时，引导线从父项文字的起笔垂下。
当前项是选中面（--qy-sidebar-current = --qy-surface-selected）：墨的透明叠合，叠在侧栏自己的底上总深一级，项目改 --qy-sidebar 时不必另设。
末位的账户入口不另设部件：MenuTrigger 的 render 交给 SidebarLink，SidebarLink 再 render 为 button（icon 放 Avatar，名称写在 MenuTrigger 的 children）。名称是按钮的可访问名称，所以 Avatar 加 aria-hidden；收起时只剩头像，名称由 Tooltip 摆出。
收起的窄轨里，二级子级与条目名称的浮层朝内联结束侧（inline-end）打开：ltr 在右，rtl 在左；窄轨二级入口与展开态一样把传入的 aria-*、data-*、事件交给触发元素。侧栏本身贴哪一边由应用的布局决定，切换按钮的图标在 rtl 下水平镜像。
侧栏最多两级（SidebarSub 下一层），第三级不进侧栏：在 SidebarSub 里再放 SidebarSub 会在开发期直接抛错（与本库其他结构契约一致，而不是悄悄多缩进一层）。第三级放在内容区，用 Tabs 或页内次级导航承载，必要时用 Breadcrumb 交代位置。见「二级导航与内容区 Tabs」。
带 SidebarGroupLabel 的 SidebarGroup 成为 role=group，名称取自标签；没有标签的分组只是排布。调用方自己给 aria-label 或 aria-labelledby 时以调用方为准。
窄屏用 drawer：同一份 children 在窄屏进入抽屉，由 SidebarDrawerTrigger 打开；抽屉里当前项照常标出，点去往新页面的条目（含客户端路由里 preventDefault 的链接）后关闭，不关的是带 aria-haspopup 的条目（如账户菜单）。服务端渲染按「够宽」输出，窄屏客户端挂载后换成抽屉。见「窄屏：抽屉承载侧栏」。

en.title: Sidebar
en.description: Persistent navigation, an icon rail when collapsed, and an expandable sub-level.
en.decisions: Collapsing produces an icon rail, not a hidden panel: navigation and links stay mounted, names switch to visually hidden (accessible name unchanged) with a Tooltip restoring a visible name; a sub-level's inline panel becomes a Popover over the same content in the rail, and its open/closed memory survives collapsing. Active and routes are explicit application facts.
notes: The expanded width defaults to --qy-sidebar-width (side insets + item padding + one icon + the gap + room for a 12-character label; 12 is a preset), and a caller's w-* still overrides it; the collapsed rail's width is one fill control height plus insets on both sides, and a visible Toggle is always available.

The current item is marked by a rounded surface one step deeper than the hover surface, plus medium weight: hover is one wash step, current is one ink step, so a row under the pointer never looks like the current one, and the weight is a second cue that does not rely on colour. The current item carries no line (user ruling: a straight line and a rounded surface are never combined on one item); the guide line beside a sub-level only expresses membership and the current item does not deepen it.
The sub-level chevron points inward when closed and down when open, the same mark as a Tree branch; when the parent has no icon, the guide line drops from the start of its text.

The current item uses the selected surface (--qy-sidebar-current = --qy-surface-selected): a translucent ink wash that always sits one step darker than the sidebar's own ground, so a project that changes --qy-sidebar need not set it.

The account entry at the end needs no part of its own: MenuTrigger renders a SidebarLink, and the SidebarLink renders a button (an Avatar as icon, the name as the MenuTrigger's children). The name is the button's accessible name, so the Avatar is aria-hidden; in the rail only the avatar remains and a Tooltip restores the name.

In the collapsed rail, the sub-level and item-name overlays open toward the inline end: right in ltr, left in rtl. The rail's sub-level entry forwards passed aria-*, data-*, and events to its trigger just as the expanded one does. The application's layout decides which edge the sidebar sits on; the toggle icon mirrors horizontally in rtl.

A sidebar has at most two levels (one under SidebarSub); the third level does not go in the sidebar. A SidebarSub inside another SidebarSub throws during development (matching the library's other structural contracts, rather than quietly indenting one more level). Put the third level in the content area, carried by Tabs or an in-page secondary nav, with a Breadcrumb to say where you are. See "Sub-level navigation with Tabs in the content".
A SidebarGroup with a SidebarGroupLabel is a role=group named by that label; a group without one is only layout. A caller's aria-label or aria-labelledby takes precedence.

Narrow screens use drawer: the same children move into a drawer opened by SidebarDrawerTrigger; the current item is marked there as usual, and activating an item that goes to a new page (including client-router links that preventDefault) closes it, except items with aria-haspopup (such as an account menu). Server rendering outputs the wide form and a narrow client swaps in the drawer after mounting. See "Narrow screens: a drawer carries the sidebar".

components.decisions: 骨架只表达「正在加载」，不表达进度，也不替应用决定何时结束，更不自行超时；到达、失败或为空时换成真内容或 Empty，不让占位一直留着。正文行高是一材，一行骨架占一材、行间不留缝，所以 N 行骨架恰是 N 行正文，内容到达版面不动。填充是清染（大面）与清墨（小条）的透明墨，不脉动：等待没有「变化」可说，循环明灭只是装饰。

en.title: Skeleton
en.description: Hold the place and row count content will take until it arrives.
en.decisions: A skeleton says only that content is loading; it carries no progress, does not decide when loading ends, and never times out by itself. On arrival, failure or an empty result it is replaced by the real content or Empty, never left in place. Body leading is one module, so a skeleton row takes one module with no gap between rows: N rows are exactly N lines of text and the page does not move on arrival. Fills are transparent ink (a faint wash for large areas, a faint ink for small bars) and do not pulse: waiting has no change to report, and a looping fade is decoration.

api.name: Sparkline
api.description: 按顺序的数值与它量的是什么。
api.descriptionEn: Ordered values and what they measure.

props.name: label
props.description: 这条线量的是什么；是可访问名称的一部分。

props.name: values
props.description: 按顺序的数值；null 表示未知，画成断开。

props.name: format
props.description: 可访问摘要和逐点提示里的读数格式；未知值不调用它。
props.descriptionEn: Formatting for values in the accessible summary and point readouts; never called for unknown values.

props.name: tooltip
props.description: 开启逐点读数。悬停显示最近点；焦点进入即显示，左右方向键、Home / End 遍历；Enter / 空格或轻点切换显示。Escape、失焦或外部按下关闭，不因仍在原位的焦点或悬停立即重开。提示显示类别、数值与点序号。默认保留静态图片摘要；空数组没有逐点入口。
props.descriptionEn: Enable point readouts. Hover shows the nearest point; focus opens it; Left/Right and Home/End traverse; Enter/Space or a tap toggles it. Escape, blur or an outside press dismiss it without immediately reopening from retained focus or hover. The hint states the category, value and point index. The default remains a static image summary; an empty array has no point target.

props.name: getPointLabel
props.description: 逐点提示的时间或类别名称，index 从 0 开始；省略或空白时使用本地化点序号。仅 tooltip 开启且有数据点时调用。
props.descriptionEn: Time or category for a point, with a zero-based index. Omitted or blank labels fall back to a localized point number. Called only when tooltip is enabled and points exist.

props.name: appearance
props.description: line 是行内趋势；area 是独立成块的趋势，取第一色并带淡面。

props.name: height
props.description: 仅 area：坐标高度（px）。

props.descriptionEn: Target range, drawn as a light-ink band across the full width behind the line; from must be below to, and label names the target in the summary. The vertical range includes it.

props.descriptionEn: Status category declared by the caller; the line, isolated points and current point (and the area fill) take its color. Omit it to stay in ink.

en.title: Sparkline
en.description: A small line set in a line of text, showing how a reading has recently changed.
en.decisions: One module tall, the line in medium ink and the current point in full ink, without hue by default. Unknown points break the line rather than becoming zero. The accessible name states the endpoints and the range. A target band is a reference: it is drawn behind the line in light ink, the vertical range includes it, and the summary adds whether the current value is above, below or within the target. The tone is declared by the caller; the component never recolors itself for leaving the band. Point readouts are opt-in: hover finds the nearest point; one focus target traverses with Left/Right and Home/End; a tap shows or dismisses the reading. Escape, blur and an outside press dismiss it. The public Tooltip provides a portal and hoverable content; unknown values remain unknown.

Escape, blur or an outside press dismiss it without immediately reopening from retained focus or hover. The hint states the category, value and point index. The default remains a static image summary; an empty array has no point target.

The default remains a static image summary; an empty array has no point target.

props.descriptionEn: Target range, drawn as a light-ink band across the full width behind the line; from must be below to, and label names the target in the summary. The vertical range includes it.

props.description: Status category declared by the caller; the line, isolated points and current point (and the area fill) take its color. Omit it to stay in ink.
props.descriptionEn: Status category declared by the caller; the line, isolated points and current point (and the area fill) take its color. Omit it to stay in ink.

props.description: Plot width in px, five modules by default; a line is always one module tall.
props.descriptionEn: Plot width in px, five modules by default; a line is always one module tall.

whenToUse: A reading needs a shape showing whether it has recently improved or worsened.
Use band when there is a real target range: the reader needs to see whether the line is inside or outside it. Without a range, draw no band.
The application decides tone: only it knows whether leaving the target is good or bad (higher latency is bad, higher output may not be); the component never recolors itself.
Enable tooltip when a short card or table trend needs occasional point inspection, and name its time or category with getPointLabel.
avoid: Use Chart or a data table for axes, multiple series or persistently visible point details.
composition: Place beside StatValue, in a table cell, or in text; the caller supplies the name and reading.

Point inspection has one Tab stop. Accessible hints retain the category, real value or unknown state, and point index. Leave room for the touch target and avoid nesting Sparkline in another button or link.

responsive: line has a fixed width and wraps with text; area fills its container when width is omitted.
Point hints use a portal to escape card and scroll-container clipping; the shared floating layer handles viewport collisions.
customization: Colors come from the ink ladder; hue appears only through tone as a status category, never as an arbitrary color.

components.name: table
components.title: 比较表 Table
components.description: 原生二维关系与完整比较列。
notes: 空结果可在完整表头下提供跨列单元格；数据与排序由应用提供。
一个范围只铺一张纸：表格进 Card 时用 framed={false}，不要在卡片里再套一层边框。
数据格与行标题允许在任意位置折行，长标识符不会把列撑出纸外；列标题保持单行。
可滚动由 ResizeObserver 实测决定；服务端与首帧按「不可滚动」输出（服务端没有布局可测，猜可滚动会让多数放得下的表带一个假停靠点），客户端在首次绘制前即更新。

api.name: TableContainer
api.description: 表格的纸与横向滚动容器。
api.descriptionEn: The table's surface and horizontal scroll container.

props.name: framed
props.description: false：表格放在已有的一张纸上（Card、面板），不再铺线、底与圆角；贴着承载面的边放置，由承载面裁切圆角。
props.descriptionEn: false places the table on an existing surface such as a Card, without its own line, fill, or radius. Set it flush with the host, which clips the corners.

props.name: tabIndex / aria-label / render / ref / native props
props.description: 内容真的超出（横向或纵向）时才可聚焦（tabIndex=0），用于键盘滚动，并成为具名区域：取 aria-label / aria-labelledby，否则沿用表的 caption 或 aria-label；放得下时不进 Tab 序列。ref 属于容器；显式传入的 tabIndex 优先。
props.descriptionEn: Focusable (tabIndex=0) only while the content actually overflows horizontally or vertically, so the keyboard can scroll it; it then becomes a named region from aria-label / aria-labelledby, else the table's caption or aria-label. A container whose content fits stays out of the Tab sequence. Ref targets the container; an explicit tabIndex wins.

api.descriptionEn: Native table / caption / thead / tbody / tfoot / tr.

props.name: TableHeader sticky / stickyOffset
props.description: 表头吸在最近的滚动区顶部：横向放得下时 TableContainer 不构成滚动容器，表头吸在页面或 Workspace 内容区；横向溢出时吸在 TableContainer 自己的有界高度里。stickyOffset 让开顶上的固定页眉，数字按 px。
props.descriptionEn: Sticks the header to the top of the nearest scroll area: when the table fits horizontally TableContainer is not a scroll container, so the header sticks to the page or Workspace content; when it overflows sideways it sticks within TableContainer's own bounded height. stickyOffset clears a fixed bar above; numbers are px.

ownProps.name: framed
ownProps.doc: false：表格放在已有的一张纸上（Card、面板），不再铺第二张——没有线、底与圆角，由承载它的纸给出。

ownProps.name: sticky
ownProps.doc:
表头吸在最近的滚动区顶部。表格横向放得下时，TableContainer 不是滚动容器（见上），表头吸在页面或 Workspace 内容区；
横向溢出、需要左右滚动的宽表，TableContainer 本身成了滚动容器，表头只在它自己的有界高度里吸住——
给 TableContainer（DataTable 的 containerProps）设了 max-height / height，或 DataTable 的虚拟化视口。
吸住时要盖住从下面滚过的行，所以底是不透明的纸（bg-surface，与 framed 的承载面同一个底）；清染表头底叠在其上。
层级 z-[1] 是预设：只需盖过同一张表里同为定位元素的固定列单元格（它们在 DOM 里排在表头之后），不参与浮层栈。

ownProps.name: stickyOffset
ownProps.doc: 吸住时离滚动区顶部的距离：滚动区顶上还有一条固定的页眉或工具栏时，让开它的高度。数字按 px，字符串是 CSS 长度（如 "var(--app-header)"）。

en.title: Table
en.description: Native two-dimensional relationships with complete comparison columns.
en.decisions: Native table structure preserves comparison; the container handles horizontal capacity. Row occupancy and cell padding consume independent roles; density values are presets.
notes: Empty results may use a spanning cell below complete headers; data and sorting belong to the application.
One region, one surface: inside a Card use framed={false} rather than nesting a second border.
Data cells and row headers wrap anywhere, so a long identifier cannot push a column off the surface; column headers stay on one line.

Scrollability is measured with a ResizeObserver. The server and first frame render as not scrollable (the server has no layout to measure, and guessing would give most fitting tables a false Tab stop); the client updates before first paint.

en.title: TagInput
en.description: Confirm a string collection while keeping its unconfirmed draft.
en.decisions: Only Enter or Add confirms a tag. Confirmation trims surrounding whitespace and deduplicates exact case-sensitive strings. Empty, duplicate, and rejected changes retain the draft.
notes: FieldLabel names the draft; FieldDescription may state confirmation and duplicate rules.

On form submit a non-empty draft is first taken in by the Enter rule; if it cannot be (duplicate, rejected by validate, not accepted by a controlled caller) the submit is stopped and the reason is shown beside the field. The submit event itself is stopped, so onSubmit does not run.
Paste only edits the draft by default; with splitOn it splits and takes in every part.
Adding/removing is not persistence. The library sends no requests and retains failed drafts.
Synthetic composition is checked; real IME and assistive tech need separate verification.

components.description: 管理整个文档的浅色 / 深色 / 跟随系统：记住用户的选择，跟随系统偏好变化，并把结果写到 <html> 上。在应用根部挂载一次，用 useTheme 读写。
notes: 防止首屏闪烁：React 挂载前页面已经绘制，需要在 <head> 里、样式表之前放一段内联脚本先应用主题。单页应用把 themeScript() 的输出粘贴进 index.html 的 <script>；服务端渲染用 <script dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: themeScript() }} />。脚本参数必须与 ThemeProvider 一致。
严格 CSP：把请求的 nonce 同时传给 <ThemeProvider nonce={nonce}> 与首屏 <script nonce={nonce} dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: themeScript() }} />；themeScript() 只返回脚本正文。没有 nonce 时切换用的临时样式被浏览器丢弃，各表面渐变而不是同时变色。
主题选择的文案用语言包中的 theme、lightTheme、darkTheme、systemTheme。
选择“跟随系统”后，操作系统切换深浅色时页面立即跟随，无需刷新。
只在根部挂载一个 ThemeProvider；局部强制深色可在容器上加 .dark 类。
服务端与客户端首渲染保持 defaultTheme，挂载后读取真实选择。存储不可用仍可改变外观；卸载清理媒体/存储监听和临时过渡样式。
默认 yq-theme 保留已有真实偏好；跨标签页删除或 clear 恢复 defaultTheme。

api.name: ThemeProvider
api.description: 主题上下文。在 <html> 上切换 .dark / .light 类（或 data-theme 属性），并同步 color-scheme。
api.descriptionEn: Theme context switches html .dark/.light classes or data-theme and synchronizes color-scheme.

props.name: defaultTheme
props.description: 没有保存过选择时使用。
props.descriptionEn: Used when no choice was saved.

props.name: storageKey
props.description: 保存到 localStorage 的键；传 null 不保存。其他标签页修改后会自动同步。
props.descriptionEn: The localStorage key; null disables persistence. Other tabs' changes synchronize automatically.

props.name: attribute
props.description: 写入方式：.dark 类，或 data-theme="dark"。两者样式都已支持。
props.descriptionEn: Write .dark classes or data-theme=dark; styles support both.

props.name: disableTransitionOnChange
props.description: 切换瞬间暂停过渡，所有表面同时变色，而不是以不同速度渐变。
props.descriptionEn: Pause transitions during switching so surfaces change together rather than fading at different speeds.

props.name: nonce
props.description: 严格 CSP（style-src 无 'unsafe-inline'）下，给切换时临时注入的 <style> 带上这个 nonce。首屏 <script> 由你自己渲染，同样要带 nonce。
props.descriptionEn: Under a strict CSP (style-src without 'unsafe-inline'), the nonce applied to the temporary <style> injected while the theme flips. You render the first-paint <script> yourself; give it the same nonce.

api.name: useTheme
api.description: 返回 { theme, resolvedTheme, setTheme }。theme 是用户的选择（可能为 system），resolvedTheme 是实际生效的 light 或 dark。必须在 ThemeProvider 内使用。
api.descriptionEn: Returns {theme,resolvedTheme,setTheme}. theme is the user's choice, possibly system; resolvedTheme is the actual light/dark mode. Requires ThemeProvider.

api.name: themeScript
api.description: 生成首屏前执行的内联脚本源码，参数与 ThemeProvider 相同（storageKey、attribute、defaultTheme）。
api.descriptionEn: Creates inline pre-paint script source with the same storageKey, attribute, and defaultTheme as ThemeProvider.

en.title: ThemeProvider
en.description: Remember the user's choice of light, dark, or system mode for the whole document. ThemeProvider follows system preference changes and applies the resolved mode to <html>. Mount it once at the app root and use useTheme to read or change the mode.
en.decisions: ThemeProvider reserves data-theme for light and dark. Store the project's brand identifier in data-brand; if ThemeProvider uses data-theme, it overwrites any brand identifier in that attribute when the mode changes.
notes: Prevent first-paint flashing with an inline head script before stylesheets, since painting precedes React mounting. In SPAs paste themeScript() into index.html script; SSR uses script dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{__html:themeScript()}}. Options must match ThemeProvider.

Strict CSP: pass the request nonce to both <ThemeProvider nonce={nonce}> and the first-paint <script nonce={nonce} dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: themeScript() }} />; themeScript() returns only the script body. Without a nonce the browser drops the temporary transition style and surfaces fade instead of changing together.
Theme choice labels use locale theme/lightTheme/darkTheme/systemTheme.
System choice follows OS light/dark changes immediately without reloading.
Mount one root ThemeProvider. Local forced-dark content may add a .dark container class.
Server/client first renders retain defaultTheme, then read actual choices after mount. Appearance can change without storage; unmount cleans media/storage listeners and temporary transition styles.
The default yq-theme key retains actual existing preferences. Cross-tab deletion/clear restores defaultTheme.
