components.name: time-field
components.title: 时间输入 TimeField
components.description: 只填一个时刻，按时、分、秒分段输入。
notes: 只填时刻用 TimeField；日期和时间一起用 DateTimePicker。
分段是 div 而不是原生输入，所以没有软键盘唤起；触屏上的输入走键盘事件，尚未单独适配。
值比分段更细时（minute 下的秒、任何粒度下的毫秒），那部分不显示，但改别的分段时照原样保留，与原生 input[type=time] 不改写 value 一致；全部清空后重新填写才是不带细部的新值。
没有弹层：时刻的取值空间很小，直接分段填比从列表里选更快。

api.name: TimeField
api.description: 一组分段的 spinbutton 加一个提交用的隐藏输入；整组由 Field 的标签命名。
api.descriptionEn: A group of segmented spinbuttons plus a hidden input for submission; the Field label names the whole group.

props.name: value / defaultValue / onValueChange
props.type: string | null / string | null / (value: string | null) => void
props.description: 传了 value 属性（含 value={null}，表示空）即受控：调用方接受回调才改变事实；调用方不接受时，分段回到已接受的值。不传 value 则非受控，defaultValue 是初值，原生表单 reset 回到它。
props.descriptionEn: Passing the value prop (including value={null} for empty) makes it controlled: only an accepted callback changes the value, and a rejected change snaps the segments back. Without it the component is uncontrolled, defaultValue is the initial value, and native form reset returns to it.

props.name: granularity
props.description: 分到哪一段为止。minute 新填出的值是 HH:mm，second 是 HH:mm:ss；不设毫秒分段。
props.descriptionEn: The last segment. A newly entered minute value is HH:mm, a second value HH:mm:ss; there is no millisecond segment.

props.name: hourCycle
props.description: 12 小时制多一个上午/下午分段，小时为 1–12；值始终是 24 小时文本。省略时取当前 locale 的习惯。
props.descriptionEn: 12-hour adds an AM/PM segment and hours run 1–12; the value is always 24-hour text. When omitted, the current locale decides.

props.name: min / max
props.description: 最早 / 最晚时刻（同形文本）。越界的值分段标 aria-invalid，并让所在表单的提交被拦下；不修正、不拒绝键入。不支持跨午夜的区间（min 晚于 max）。
props.descriptionEn: Earliest and latest time (same text shape). A value outside marks the segments aria-invalid and blocks submission of its form; typing is neither corrected nor refused. Ranges that cross midnight (min later than max) are not supported.

props.name: name / form
props.description: 隐藏输入参与原生 FormData，提交 ISO 文本；未填完整时提交空串。Field 的 name 可代为命名。
props.descriptionEn: The hidden input joins native FormData and submits the ISO text; an incomplete time submits an empty string. A Field name can supply the name.

props.name: disabled / readOnly / required
props.description: disabled 的分段离开 Tab 序且值不提交（Field 与 fieldset 的禁用同样生效）；readOnly 的值仍可聚焦、读取、提交，但不能编辑；required 让空值拦下提交。
props.descriptionEn: Disabled segments leave the tab order and do not submit (Field and fieldset disabling apply too). Read-only values stay focusable, readable and submitted but cannot be edited. required blocks submission while empty.

props.name: aria-label / aria-labelledby / className / style / ref
props.description: 属于整组的外壳。字段外使用时必须自带 aria-label 或 aria-labelledby，缺名称会抛错；在 Field 里由 FieldLabel 命名。
props.descriptionEn: Applied to the group shell. Outside a Field one of aria-label or aria-labelledby is required and a missing name throws; inside a Field the FieldLabel names it.

components.decisions: value 是与原生 input[type=time] 同形的无时区文本（HH:mm、HH:mm:ss，秒后可带 1–3 位小数），空为 null。每一段都填了才有值：还差几段的中间态不上报，把已有的完整时间清掉时上报 null。越界的值照常上报，只把分段标为无效并让表单提交被拦下，说明文字由应用用 FieldError 给出。

en.title: TimeField
en.description: Fill in a time of day alone, segment by segment: hour, minute, second.
en.decisions: The value is zone-free text shaped like native input[type=time] (HH:mm or HH:mm:ss, optionally with a 1–3 digit fraction of a second); empty is null. A value exists only when every segment is filled: in-between states are not reported, and clearing a complete time reports null. Out-of-range values are still reported; they only mark the segments invalid and block form submission, and the application states the reason with FieldError.
notes: Use TimeField for a time of day alone; use DateTimePicker for date and time together.
Segments are divs, not native inputs, so no soft keyboard is raised; touch entry goes through key events and has not been adapted separately.

When a value is finer than the segments (seconds under minute, milliseconds under any granularity), that part is not shown but survives edits to other segments, as native input[type=time] never rewrites its value; only clearing every segment and entering again yields a new value without it.
There is no popup: a time of day has a small value space, and filling segments is faster than choosing from a list.

components.name: toast
components.title: 通知 Toast
components.description: 补充可恢复、非关键的操作事实，保持当前工作不中断。
notes: 悬停、聚焦与窗口失焦暂停自动消失。
通知只呈现应用给出的类型，不做推测：没有超时转未知，等待、进行中、未知与失败一直留到应用更新或用户关闭。loadingTimeout 已移除；需要期限时由应用计时并调用 toastManager.update(id, { type: "unknown" })。
测试里按文字查找通知时限定在通知区域内（role=region）或用 data-slot=toast-title：priority=high 的通知另有一份视觉隐藏的播报副本，焦点进入通知区域后副本移除。
带动作（如「撤销」）的通知同样不自动消失，动作需要时间；它们和失败、未知、进行中的通知一样不会被数量上限收起。锚定通知没有统一的通知区，超限的一般通知只收起、不显示数量。
普通成功默认短暂；失败/未知持续但仍可关闭。重要事实和恢复入口必须留在对象页面。
Viewport 与锚定通知消费共享 notification 层级，低于文档候选与 modal 关键动作。

api.name: toastManager.promise(promise, { loading, success, error })
api.description: 进行中→真实成功/失败，更新同一条。通知不设期限、不推断结果：等多久都保持进行中，直到 Promise 落定或应用更新。响应丢失时由应用把这一条改为 unknown，不能将网络拒绝当业务失败。

The notice sets no deadline and infers no outcome: it stays in progress however long it takes, until the promise settles or the application updates it. When a response is lost the application changes the notice to unknown; network rejection is not a business failure.

components.decisions: 通知不抢焦点。未知表示结果未确认，失败表示已有失败事实；关闭只关闭通知。字段错误、不可逆后果和需决策的失败留在工作面或确认结构，不能只用 Toast。

en.title: Toast
en.description: Report recoverable, non-critical facts while the current work continues.
en.decisions: A notification does not take focus. Unknown means no reliable result; failed means a confirmed failure. Dismissal only closes the notification. Keep field errors, irreversible consequences and decisions on the task surface or in a confirmation structure.
notes: Hover, focus, and window blur pause automatic disappearance.

A notice only presents the type the application gives it and infers nothing: no timeout turns it into unknown, and waiting, in-progress, unknown and failed notices stay until the application updates them or the user closes them. loadingTimeout is removed; when a deadline is needed the application times it and calls toastManager.update(id, { type: "unknown" }).

In tests, scope text queries to the notification region (role=region) or use data-slot=toast-title: a priority=high notice also has a visually hidden announcement copy, removed once focus enters the region.

Action-bearing notices (for example Undo) do not auto-dismiss either, because acting takes time; like failed, unknown and in-progress notices they are never collapsed by the limit. Anchored notices have no shared region, so surplus ordinary ones are collapsed without a count.
Ordinary success is brief by default; failure/unknown stay but can close. Important facts and recovery entries remain on the object's page.
Viewport and anchored notices consume shared notification layers, below document candidates and critical modal actions.

components.name: toc
components.title: 阅读目录 Toc
components.description: 本页内几个段落之间走动的纵向目录：当前位置把一条清墨基线上自己那一段加深为焦墨，不新增形状。
notes: 当前项不改字重，只加深线段与文字墨色，避免整排因变宽而跳动。
强制颜色（高对比度）下当前项另加一道下划线：边线被系统统一着色后不再区分当前项。
二级目录到基线 = 组内间隔；三级在此基础上再加层级缩进（--qy-level-indent），两个既有关系相加，不是新值。

whenToUse: 一篇长文或文档页需要在几个段落间快速定位，并看到自己读到了哪一节。
avoid: 少于两个目的地时目录没有意义，由调用方决定是否渲染（Toc 本身只在 items 为空时不渲染）。
跨页面的目的地用 Breadcrumb 或 NavigationMenu；Toc 只表达同一页内的位置。
composition: items 可以手写，也可以用 useTocHeadings 从容器里扫描 h2/h3[id]（Prose 渲染的标题天然满足）。
current 可以手动受控，也可以用 useTocScrollSpy 按滚动位置计算；两者都是可选项，不用也能渲染一份纯目录。
纵向导航线复用 src/nav-line.ts 的机制（与 Tabs、NavigationMenu 的横向导航线同源，只换轴向）。

library: 目录的排版、层级缩进、当前项的视觉表达。
application: 标题的真实 id、滚动容器、吸顶偏移、是否需要目录（少于两项时渲染与否）。

en.title: Toc
en.description: A vertical in-page table of contents for moving between sections; the current location deepens its own segment of an existing thin line instead of adding a new shape.
en.decisions: Toc neither reads routing nor performs smooth scrolling: <a href="#id"> is a native anchor jump; sticky-header offsets and router integration stay with the project. The current location is supplied by the caller — the component never guesses scroll position — and useTocScrollSpy is an optional utility, not a hidden dependency of Toc.
notes: The current item does not change font weight; only the line segment and text ink deepen, so the row never shifts width.
In forced colors (high contrast) the current item also gets an underline: once the system recolors every border, the line no longer tells the current item apart.
Level 2 sits one relationship gap from the baseline; level 3 adds the existing level indent on top — two existing relationships added together, not a new value.

components.decisions: expandedIds 与 selectedId 分开；聚焦不选择，隐藏节点不强行清除既有选择。checkable 与 selectable 的点击不组合：checkable 为 true 时行点击与 Space 勾选，不再单选，避免同一次点击承担两种互相冲突的意图。checkedIds 只含叶子节点 id；分支的勾选是派生显示（true / false / mixed），从不写回值，避免「勾一个分支」被多计成 N+1 项。级联只触达启用的叶子：禁用节点保留给定的勾选事实，不被祖先的勾选/取消改变；分支在其启用的叶子后代全部勾选时显示为已勾选，即使存在未勾选的禁用后代。

en.title: Tree
en.description: Hierarchy, expansion, focus, independent single selection, and an optional cascading checkable mode for stable nodes.
en.decisions: Expanded IDs and selected ID are separate; focus never selects, and hidden nodes do not automatically clear selection. Checkable and selectable clicks do not combine: when checkable is true, row clicks and Space toggle the check instead of selecting, so one click never carries two conflicting intents. checkedIds holds only leaf ids; a branch's checked state is a derived display (true / false / mixed) and is never written back into the value, so checking one branch cannot be miscounted as N+1 items. Cascade only touches enabled leaves: a disabled node keeps the checked fact it was given and cascade from an ancestor never changes it; a branch displays as fully checked once every one of its enabled leaf descendants is checked, even with unchecked disabled descendants remaining.
notes: Removing a focused node finds an enabled fallback; clearing returns owned focus to the container without stealing outside focus.

props.name: nodes

props.name: value / defaultValue / onValueChange
props.description: 单选是所选节点的 id（分支也可被选），null 是未选择；选中即提交并关闭，重选同一节点只关闭。多选是已勾选的叶子 id，勾选不关闭，回调里的 ids 按树的顺序。回调的 details 与 Tree 同形，cancel() 后不提交（单选时弹层也保持打开）。

props.name: placeholder

en.title: TreeSelect
en.description: Choose one node, or check several leaves, on a tree inside a popup.
en.decisions: The single value is a node id and a branch can be chosen; the multiple value holds leaf ids only, and a branch's check is a derived display, the same convention as Tree's checkable, so checking one branch is never miscounted as N+1 items. TreeSelect owns the expansion and recomputes it from the chosen nodes on every open, because closing the popup unmounts the Tree.
notes: No search and no async loading: typing the start of a label jumps to it, and the caller provides all nodes at once.

The trigger is a combobox and the popup a tree (aria-haspopup="tree"). In multiple mode the trigger lists the checked leaves; beyond two it reads "first and N more", and the rest stay visible in the tree.

components.name: virtual-list
components.title: 虚拟列表 VirtualList
components.description: 以稳定项身份呈现等高或动态高度长集合，保留阅读位置与正在编辑的内容。
notes: 固定模式保持 itemSize 契约；内容会换行、展开或流式增长时显式选 dynamic，并给未测量行合理估计。动态跳转可随实际测量修正位置，不承诺平滑滚动。
稳定 key 在前插和排序后保留同一可见项及项内像素偏移；视口上方整行高度变化会补偿滚动。尾部跟随不代替应用的未读计数或加载状态。
键只在 items 或 getKey 变化时派生。滚动时只处理窗口和最多一个保留焦点行，不重新遍历 50,000 项；数据变化或测量更新仍可能更新尺寸缓存。
聚焦行即使离屏也保留挂载；真实移除后焦点回到视口。aria-posinset/setsize 表达完整集合位置。搜索、打印或需要全量辅助技术遍历时改用普通集合或 ScrollArea。
窗口示例的 48px 等高、动态示例的 72px 估计及视口高度均是消费示例选择，修改入口为 itemSize/height；未新增库 token。

api.name: VirtualList<Item>
api.description: 集合渲染边界，真实 list/listitem，不提供选择、请求或业务列。
api.descriptionEn: Collection rendering boundary with actual list/listitem semantics, without selection, requests, or business columns.

props.name: items / getKey / renderItem
props.description: 真实集合、稳定唯一 key 与内容；重复 key 显式报错。插入、排序时用持久身份，不用位置。
props.descriptionEn: Actual collection, stable unique keys, and content; duplicate keys throw. Use persistent identities across insertion and reordering, rather than positions.

props.name: itemSize / height
props.description: 项外高与视口高，CSS px，均为有限正数。默认固定高度；动态模式中 itemSize 是未测量行的估计值，不限制内容高度。
props.descriptionEn: Outer item height and viewport height in CSS px, both finite and positive. Rows are fixed by default; in dynamic mode itemSize estimates unmeasured rows without constraining their content height.

props.name: measurement
props.description: dynamic 用 ResizeObserver 测量已挂载行的实际 border-box 高度；整行高度应由正常内容流决定，外部 margin 不计入测量。
props.descriptionEn: dynamic uses ResizeObserver to measure each mounted row's actual border-box height. Let normal content flow determine row height; external margins are excluded.

props.name: actionsRef
props.description: 独立动作出口：scrollToIndex(index, { align?: 'auto' | 'start' | 'center' | 'end' }) 与 scrollToEnd()。立即滚动，不转移焦点。非法或越界 index 抛 RangeError；空集合 scrollToEnd 无操作。
props.descriptionEn: Separate actions: scrollToIndex(index, { align?: 'auto' | 'start' | 'center' | 'end' }) and scrollToEnd(). Scroll instantly without moving focus. Invalid or out-of-bounds indices throw RangeError; scrollToEnd is a no-op for empty collections.

props.name: followEnd
props.description: 显式尾部跟随。仅原先停在底部（1 CSS px 容差）时跟随追加项；向上阅读后保持阅读位置，不在初次挂载时跳到底部。
props.descriptionEn: Explicit end following. Follow appended items only when previously at the bottom (within 1 CSS px). Reading history keeps its position, and initial mounting never jumps to the end.

props.name: overscan
props.description: 窗口两侧的渲染预算预设，非负整数；不是视觉尺寸。
props.descriptionEn: A nonnegative integer rendering-budget preset on both window edges, rather than a visual dimension.

props.description: 必填其一：集合的可识别名称，落在 role=list 的滚动视口上；缺失或为空时抛错。
props.descriptionEn: One is required: the identifiable name of the collection, on the role=list scroll viewport. A missing or blank name throws.

en.title: Virtual list
en.description: Window fixed or measured-height collections while retaining the reading position and active editing.
en.decisions: VirtualList owns windowing, measurement, reading anchors, and focus continuity. The consumer owns the collection, stable keys, unread state, and following policy; fixed heights and manual scrolling remain the defaults.
notes: Fixed mode retains the itemSize contract. Explicitly choose dynamic for wrapping, expanding, or streaming content and provide a reasonable estimate. Dynamic jumps may correct their position as measurements arrive; smooth scrolling is not promised.

Stable keys retain the visible item and within-item pixel offset across prepends and reorders. Height changes of rows entirely above the viewport compensate the scroll offset. Following does not own unread counts or loading state.

Keys are derived only when items or getKey change. Scrolling processes the window and at most one retained focused row, without rewalking 50,000 items. Data changes or measurements can still update the size cache.

Focused rows remain mounted offscreen; actual removal returns focus to the viewport. aria-posinset/setsize express complete collection positions. Use ordinary collections or ScrollArea for search, printing, or complete assistive-technology traversal.
The fixed demo's 48px rows, dynamic demo's 72px estimate, and viewport heights are consumer choices adjusted through itemSize/height. No library token was added.

components.name: workspace
components.title: 工作面 Workspace
components.description: 应用外壳：底纸上的侧栏旁放一张工作面，顶栏在工作面里，下面是唯一的滚动区。
notes: 顶栏是一个 header；不在 main、section 或 article 里时，它是页面的 banner 地标。内容区是 main，一页只放一个 Workspace。
Workspace 自带跳过链接（「跳到主要内容」）：键盘第一次 Tab 时出现，回车把焦点交给 WorkspaceContent；内容区的 id 由外壳生成，传入 id 时以传入的为准。换页后由应用把焦点移到 WorkspaceContent；调用方显式传入的 tabIndex 优先。
送进顶栏的内容在首次提交后出现（服务端渲染时不在 HTML 里）；需要首屏就有标题时，直接写在 WorkspaceHeader 的 children 里。
强制颜色下阴影被移除，工作面的范围由容器线承担，不需要额外补线。
WorkspaceTitle 是页面唯一的 h1；内容区里不要再放 PageHeader 的标题，需要分段时用 level 2 起的标题。

en.title: Workspace
en.description: An application shell: a sidebar on the page ground beside one work surface, with the header inside the surface and the only scroll container below it.
en.decisions: A page's name, summary and page-level actions live in the header, so the body has no second large title. The surface keeps a 2-unit margin all round except on the side facing the sidebar: that gap is the sidebar's own inset, so sidebar and surface read as one gap apart. At narrow width the surface fills the viewport, with no margin, radius, line or shadow. A routed page sends its title and actions to the header with WorkspaceHeaderPortal; the header precedes the content in the DOM, so those actions also precede the body in tab order.
notes: The header is a header element; outside main, section and article it is the page's banner landmark. The content is main, so place one Workspace per page.

Workspace carries its own skip link ('Skip to main content'): it appears on the first Tab and Enter moves focus to WorkspaceContent; the shell generates the content's id, and an id you pass wins. After navigation the application moves focus to WorkspaceContent; an explicit tabIndex from the caller wins.
Content sent to the header appears after the first commit (it is not in server HTML); write the title directly as WorkspaceHeader's children when it must be there on first paint.
In forced colors the shadow is removed and the container line carries the surface's boundary; no extra line is needed.
WorkspaceTitle is the page's only h1; do not add a PageHeader title inside the content, and start sections at level 2.

methods: Complementary roles and safeguards （相成相制）
Space supports the task （布白有用）
whenToUse: The shell of an admin-style application: persistent navigation at the side, one work surface for the current page.
avoid: Do not use it for reading-first pages that scroll as a whole, such as documentation or landing pages; use Section for a stretch of body content and Card for an independent object.
The header holds only this page's title, summary and page-level actions; the application places global entries such as search or notifications without taking the title's width.
Do not nest a second identical sheet inside the surface.
composition: Workspace holds a Sidebar and a WorkspaceSurface; the surface holds WorkspaceHeader then WorkspaceContent.
The page sets the content inset: --qy-page-gutter lines it up with the header title; a full-width table may run to the edge.
Inside WorkspaceContent a page wraps WorkspaceTitle, WorkspaceSummary and WorkspaceActions in WorkspaceHeaderPortal.

See /examples/records: Stack holds filters and DataTablePattern; hide detail for a list, or use a minmax(0,…) grid for list and detail. WorkspaceContent owns vertical scrolling; TableContainer handles horizontal overflow. Pagination scrolls with the list; the header stays fixed.

The active record is independent from batch selection. Filtering and paging retain the active record and notes keyed by stable ID. Detail sits alongside the list at xl and stacks below it otherwise; 2:1 is a capacity choice for this task.

library: The shell geometry, the header's row height and midline, the header's slot for the page, and the content's scrolling and focus target.
application: Routing, the current item, the page title and summary, the real targets of actions, and moving focus to the content after navigation.

responsive: At narrow width (the library's single sm: point) the surface fills the viewport; whether the sidebar collapses or becomes a drawer is the application's choice.
customization: className, render and ref belong to each part; the shell reads only system roles (ground, paper, container line, panel radius, panel shadow, page gutter, row height) and adds no component tokens.
